job.title: Senior Cloud-Native Application Architect
job.description:
Senior Cloud-Native Application Architect
Long Term Contract
Location: Dallas, TX (Downtown)
Work Arrangement: Hybrid – 2 Days Onsite Weekly
Contract Duration: 24+ Months

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Cloud-Native Application Architect to lead the technical design and modernization of enterprise web platforms. This position focuses on building scalable, secure, and resilient applications using modern JavaScript frameworks, cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, and enterprise integration technologies.

The architect will establish technical direction across application development, cloud infrastructure, security, and integration teams. Responsibilities include evaluating existing systems, designing future-state architectures, defining reusable engineering standards, and supporting the deployment of enterprise applications.

Qualified candidates should have a strong background in application architecture, hands-on knowledge of React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, and TypeScript, and the ability to architect applications deployed within Red Hat OpenShift and other cloud-native environments.

Key Responsibilities
  • Enterprise Application Design & Modernization
  • Modern Web Platforms & Development Standards
  • Cloud Infrastructure & Container Architecture
  • API, Identity & Enterprise Integration
  • Security, Reliability & Technical Governance
===========================================

Required Qualifications
  • Substantial background designing and delivering enterprise applications in a Solution Architect, Application Architect, Technical Architect, or comparable leadership role.

  • Strong knowledge of modern web development architecture, particularly React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript.

  • Practical understanding of server-side application architecture, API development, and distributed application design.

  • Architecture and deployment knowledge of Red Hat OpenShift, including containerized application design and Kubernetes orchestration.

  • Knowledge of AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and cloud-native application deployment practices.

  • Strong understanding of API management, API gateways, enterprise identity integration, and event-streaming technologies such as Kafka.

  • Proficiency with RESTful services, microservices, service integration patterns, and asynchronous communication.

  • Understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, container configuration, networking, and application deployment strategies.

  • Knowledge of application security, authentication and authorization protocols, CI/CD processes, and DevSecOps practices.

  • Ability to design systems that meet performance, availability, resiliency, scalability, and observability requirements.

  • Ability to translate complex technical requirements into practical solutions and communicate architectural decisions to engineering teams and business stakeholders.

Additional Qualifications
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies, distributed tracing, and cloud-native monitoring platforms.

  • Background modernizing legacy applications and migrating workloads into containerized or cloud-hosted environments.

  • Knowledge of infrastructure automation, automated testing, and continuous delivery.

  • Understanding of enterprise architecture governance and architecture review processes.

  • Previous work in energy, utilities, critical infrastructure, highly regulated industries, or other large enterprise environments is beneficial but not required.

job.title: Senior Multi-Housing Portfolio Analyst
job.description:
Senior Affordable Housing Analyst Contract: 12+ months
Schedule: Hybrid; onsite Tuesday through Thursday, remote Monday and Friday

Position Overview

The Senior multifamily Analyst evaluates, underwrites, funds, and monitors affordable housing projects. The role reviews multifamily rental and owner-occupied applications, assesses project and funding viability, and ensures compliance with applicable program requirements. The analyst also provides guidance to financial institutions, nonprofit organizations, and community or government partners.

Key Responsibilities
  • Review affordable housing applications and funding requests; verify supporting documents and recommend approval or denial.

  • Analyze multifamily project budgets, funding, 15-year pro formas, rent rolls, tenant files, appraisals, market studies, and loan documents.

  • Review construction draw requests and project disbursements to assess funding eligibility and project viability.

  • Monitor affordable housing properties and review project status, rent, income targeting, and other compliance requirements.

  • Provide technical assistance to financial institutions, nonprofit organizations, and community or government leaders.

  • Coordinate with other analysts on complex applications, modifications, funding requests, and monitoring issues.

  • Prepare project updates, status reports, recommendations, and program materials.

  • Support workshops, webinars, system testing, and related department operations.

Required Qualifications
  • 5 years of financial analysis, credit underwriting, commercial real estate, multifamily housing, housing development, or comparable affordable housing experience.

  • Experience with multifamily rental properties, including property monitoring and review of rent rolls and tenant files.

  • Experience with affordable housing programs, LIHTC compliance, or federal, state, or municipal housing programs.

  • Experience reviewing affordable housing ownership, property management, funding, or construction draw documentation.

  • Strong Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Adobe Acrobat skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with affordable housing equity investments, tax credits, portfolio performance, or municipal and other government contracts.

  • Completion of major corporate bank credit training or equivalent experience.

  • Master’s degree in public administration or a related field.

  • Grow America or comparable housing certification.

job.title: Leave & Accommodations Associate (Junior)
job.description:
Junior HR Leave & Accommodations Associate
6+ month contract
Fort Mill, SC (Hybrid)

Position Summary
The Leave & Accommodations Associate will provide temporary administrative support to the Leave & Accommodations team. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their HR career who is organized, detail-oriented, and interested in gaining experience in leave administration and workplace accommodations.

The role will assist with employee inquiries, documentation, data entry, case follow-up, and coordination with internal partners and the third-party leave administrator.

Responsibilities
  • Respond to routine employee questions related to leaves of absence and accommodations.
  • Monitor the leave and accommodation mailbox and help ensure inquiries receive timely responses.
  • Enter and update leave and accommodation information in Workday.
  • Assist with coordinating leave requests between employees and the third-party leave administrator.
  • Track requests, documentation, and outstanding follow-up items.
  • Provide employees with required accommodation paperwork and follow up on outstanding documentation.
  • Support communication with HR partners, Payroll, and managers regarding leave and accommodation matters.
  • Assist with Paid Parental Benefit requests.
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation.
  • Escalate questions or more complex cases to the appropriate team member.

Qualifications
  • High school diploma required; bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferred.
  • 1–2 years of HR, administrative, benefits, or related experience preferred.
  • Previous leave of absence or accommodation experience is helpful but not required.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple requests and priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable handling sensitive and confidential information.
  • Proficiency in Outlook, Excel, and Word.
  • Experience with Workday and/or Smartsheet is a plus.
  • Comfortable learning and navigating multiple systems and web-based tools.

job.title: Senior Azure Data Engineer
job.description:
Senior Azure Data Engineer (Azure Databricks)
Direct Hire
Plano, TX (Hybrid)
 
Overview
We’re partnering with a confidential, enterprise-scale organization to hire a Senior Azure Data Engineer with deep expertise in Azure Databricks to help design, build, and optimize a modern lakehouse data platform. You’ll develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, implement Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) patterns, and enable advanced analytics in a high-volume environment. This role collaborates closely with data architects, data scientists, business stakeholders, and cloud/infrastructure teams to deliver secure, reliable, high-performance data solutions.
What You’ll Do
  • Design and build scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks (PySpark, Spark SQL).
  • Develop ingestion workflows from multiple source systems (e.g., Event Hub, APIs, Azure SQL, Blob Storage) into Bronze/Silver/Gold layers.
  • Implement best practices for Delta Lake and Unity Catalog (schema evolution, versioning, governance).
  • Optimize pipeline performance and cost through partitioning, caching, clustering, and Spark tuning.
  • Integrate Databricks with ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Synapse, Event Hub, Key Vault, and Azure DevOps.
  • Implement secure access controls using managed identities, RBAC, and data protection practices (e.g., masking).
  • Partner with analytics and business teams to deliver trusted datasets, metrics, and KPIs.
  • Provide technical leadership through mentoring, code reviews, and architectural guidance.
  • Work with enterprise architecture and security teams to align with data privacy/security policies.
  • Implement data quality checks, alerting, and lineage tracking using tools such as Great Expectations, Unity Catalog, and data observability platforms.
  • Build monitoring dashboards, alerts, and recovery mechanisms for critical pipelines.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of data engineering experience, including 3+ years with Azure Databricks / Apache Spark (PySpark).
  • Strong experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks notebooks, and SQL-based warehousing patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with ADLS Gen2, Event Hub, ADF, Key Vault, Synapse.
  • Strong coding skills in Python and SQL; familiarity with Scala is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling (OLTP/OLAP), star/snowflake schemas, and performance tuning.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD for Databricks using Databricks CLI, Terraform, and/or Azure DevOps.
  • Databricks certification (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional).
  • Streaming/real-time pipelines (Structured Streaming, Event Hub, Kafka).
  • ML platform exposure (e.g., MLflow or supporting ML pipelines).
  • Reporting/consumption layer experience (e.g., Power BI, Purview, Microsoft Fabric).
  • Knowledge of governance/compliance standards (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2).

job.title: Engr Program Management 3 - Hybrid in San Mateo or San Diego
job.description:
SENIOR PROGRAM MANAGER - HYBRID IN SAN MATEO OR SAN DIEGO

*CANDIDATES MUST BE ABLE TO WORK DIRECTLY ON A W2 WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP. NO C2C!!
  • 6 month contract 
  • $100-120/hr on W2 
Why PlayStation?
PlayStation isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Today, we’re recognized as a global leader in entertainment producing The PlayStation family of products and services including PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, PlayStation®VR, PlayStation®Plus, PlayStation™Now, acclaimed PlayStation software titles from PlayStation Studios, and more.
 
About The Role:
PlayStation Global Program Management Office drives delivery of highly impactful program solutions worldwide. We are looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager with a strong player-focused mindset and a proven track record of delivering software and driving results that support player needs, business goals, and organizational priorities. This role will be responsible for driving programs and projects from inception through deployment over a worldwide scale. The candidate will successfully partner with a globally distributed cross-functional team (product engineering, product management, business operations, marketing, consumer support, legal, finance) to ensure product and operational readiness for market delivery.
 
You will bring your expertise to deliver complex programs by demonstrating excellent planning, execution, partner, risk and dependency management skills. You will be hands on to tackle challenges, an advocate and the biggest supporter for the program organization.
 
What You'll Do:
  • Own and drive end-to-end delivery of multiple strategic and complex cross-regional, cross-functional initiatives with multi-level dependencies.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop full program plans including timelines, dependencies, risk factors, success criteria, and outcomes, while keeping them energized and focused on delivering priority programs
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Senior Leadership to drive programs strategically
  • Understand strategy, objectives, priority and goals to translate into tactical execution plans
  • Identify, understand, visualize and manage upstream/downstream dependencies
  • Anticipate and remove obstacles proactively and effectively
  • Ensure clear communication for status reporting, issues and challenges to leadership, relevant partners, and team members
  • Lead continuous improvement efforts to optimize productivity and processes for the organization
  • Bring clarity, calm and process to ambiguous, stressful and/or sophisticated situations
  • Build a strong cohesive program team and create a fun and collaborative environment that cultivates creativity, innovation, learning and inclusivity
  • Drive software development programs that involve integrating server and client engineering work from inception to delivery to internal / external customers
 
Basic Qualifications:
  • 5+ years of program management experience with software development and delivery at scale
  • Bachelor’s degree, technical education and/or work experience in technical domain
  • Consistent track record of managing schedules, scope, budgets, dependency, issues/risks, communications, quality/testing plans, and release plans of complex programs
  • Shown technical proficiency and an ability to understand technology, designs, challenges and risks
  • Proven understanding of Software Development Lifecycle, Design/System Thinking, Agile frameworks, preferably Scrum and Kanban, and Program Management Methodologies to implement the right practice for the programs
  • Experience in leading complex, business-critical programs with dependencies across multiple teams to include Product Management, User Experience, Legal, Marketing and other business teams
  • Experience creating and delivering executive-level summary reports and presentations
  • Excellent listening, written, and verbal communication skills across all levels
  • Strong decision-making skill, conflict resolution and navigating through the organization
  • Experience in initiating and driving process improvements
  • Experience with collaboration tools (Jira, Confluence, Trello, Google Drive, and Microsoft Teams, etc)
 
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience working with globally distributed teams and multicultural working environments
  • Experience in a high transaction network based services, video gaming industry or social media
  • Domain expertise in one or more of the following areas: video gaming, accounts platform, trust & safety, account management, process implementation, mobile, and/or web development
  • Understanding of Japanese language and culture

job.title: Senior Business Coordinator - Contract, Onsite Only - Central Austin, Texas
job.description:
Senior Business Coodinator 
Centrail Austin Location 
$29 per hour
1 year contract with possible extension
Benefits insurance offerd by Yoh Staffing

General Overview:
At a senior level, supports general business operations by performing a variety of support activities. This position utilizes in-depth knowledge of best practices and experience in own discipline to provide and improve services. Takes a new perspective to solve complex problems. Works independently and receives minimal guidance. Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience.
This position provides department-specific support within assigned area, which may include any of the following:
• Serves as a resource to department and other internal staff on various aspects of department operations.
Creates and maintains clear and accurate departmental procedures documents.
Supports departmental initiatives
Identify issues or opportunities for improvement in proceesses and makes recommendations to resolve them.
• Assists department in activities such as preparing reports, budgets, and correspondence.
• Performs analysis and/or research in support of business operations.
• Coordinates with other departments and serves as a primary point of contact for inter-departmental activities.
• Provides information and basic training to department staff related to systems, processes and projects.
• Monitors and maintains department records such as budgets, work plans, schedules, and projects.
• Prepares, types, and processes forms such as those needed for office supplies, expense reports, time sheets, Procards, and other department-related forms.
• Processes accounts payable/receivable ensuring timeliness, accuracy and appropriate backup.
• Responds to requests for information concerning department operations and/or refers requests to appropriate staff members.
• Maintains information and stores and uses data through various software programs, spreadsheets and databases.
• Coordinates and schedules external and internal meetings, training activities, and seminars, to include the possibility of meal coordination, pick-up, and set-up.
• May make travel arrangements for department staff, including transportation and hotel arrangements, as directed.
• May act as a primary or back-up timekeeper.
• May manage a department or corporate program.
This general overview only includes essential functions of the job and does not imply that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instruction and to perform any other job-related duties requested by supervisor or management.
Minimum Qualifications:
Six or more years of administrative, business, operations, or other relevant experience.
A degree in a relevant field may be substituted per LCRA guidelines for certain years of experience.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
• Knowledge of departments operational procedures
• Skill in verbal and written communication
• Skill in communicating effectively with team members, supervision, and internal/external contacts in a professional manner
• Skill in using typical office machines
• Skill in organization
• Skill in establishing concrete, actionable work plans from ambiguous information and directives
• Skill in providing customer service
• Skill in meeting deadlines
• Skill in office productivity applications (such as email, word processing, spreadsheets, etc.)
• Skill in using software for electronically store corporate data and files
• Ability to understand and implement policies and procedures
• Ability to build relationships and foster teamwork
• Ability to work in a team environment
• Ability to maintain confidentiality
• Ability to balance and manage competing high priority work demands
Work Environment:
• Work hours are primarily spent in an office environment
• For some departments, work may be performed by traveling with other staff to various locations as necessary
Physical Demands:
• Work involves frequent finger/hand manipulation in using a keyboard and mouse
• Work may involve lifting and carrying up to 25-50 pounds less than 20% of the time
• Work may involve pushing and pulling up to 25 pounds less than 20% of the time

  • The Accommodation Specialist holds primary responsibility for managing the disability and pregnancy-related accommodation process for employees and applicants for employment.
  • Assess, coordinate, and implement reasonable accommodations for faculty and staff by working collaboratively with other key members of the university including, Human Resources, department managers, and the Office of General Counsel.

Full Stack Engineer (Python, Go, React, Agentic AI, AI coding tools)
12+ month contract
Plano, TX (Hybrid)
 
Position Overview
Seeking a Full Stack Engineer to design, develop, and support modern cloud-based applications and automation solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong full-stack development experience, hands-on AWS expertise, and an interest in leveraging agentic AI and AI-assisted coding tools to improve engineering productivity and solution delivery.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack applications and services.
  • Build scalable solutions using technologies such as Python, Go, JavaScript, and React.
  • Develop and integrate cloud-based applications using AWS services, including ECS and RDS.
  • Create and maintain containerized applications using Docker.
  • Build and enhance CI/CD pipelines to support reliable software delivery.
  • Design and automate MCP and agentic AI solutions.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools, including Claude Code and Codex, to improve coding efficiency, testing, documentation, and automation.
  • Integrate applications with APIs and troubleshoot complex integration issues.
  • Monitor application performance and reliability using tools such as AWS CloudWatch and New Relic.
  • Collaborate with engineers, technical leads, product partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, testing, and production support activities.
 
Requirments
  • Professional experience developing full-stack software applications.
  • Strong experience with one or more of the following: Python, Go, JavaScript, or React.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services, particularly ECS and RDS.
  • Experience with Docker and containerized application development.
  • Experience developing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs and system integrations.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience designing or implementing MCP-based solutions.
  • Experience with agentic AI architecture, automation, or workflow development.
  • Experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex.
  • Experience with AWS CloudWatch and New Relic.
  • Familiarity with modern software architecture and cloud-native development practices.
  • Experience supporting applications in production environments.

job.title: MS Dynamics AX / 365 SME
job.description:
Microsoft Dynamics AX / D365 Subject Matter Expert (SME)
Contract/Contract to Hire/Direct Hire
Addison, TX (Hybrid)

Overview We are preparing for a company-wide ERP transformation with the implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365, scheduled to begin in Q1. We are seeking an experienced Microsoft Dynamics AX / Dynamics 365 Subject Matter Expert (SME) to serve as the organization's internal ERP expert and key liaison with our implementation partner.
This individual will play a critical role throughout the ERP migration, advocating for business needs, ensuring system decisions align with operational requirements, and helping drive a successful implementation. Following the project, this person will continue to support, optimize, and enhance the ERP environment as a long-term member of the team.
We are looking for someone committed to seeing the project through to completion while helping the business prepare for a successful go-live and future growth.

Key Responsibilities
Business Process Analysis & Requirements Gathering
  • Lead workshops and discovery sessions with stakeholders across the organization to understand current business processes and future-state requirements.
  • Translate business needs into functional ERP requirements and collaborate with implementation partners on solution design.
  • Conduct fit-gap analyses to identify process improvements, configuration requirements, and areas requiring customization.
ERP Configuration & Solution Design
  • Partner with implementation consultants to configure and optimize Dynamics 365 modules, including areas such as:
    • General Ledger
    • Accounts Payable
    • Accounts Receivable
    • Fixed Assets
    • Inventory Management
    • Warehouse Management
    • Procurement and Supply Chain
  • Ensure configurations align with business objectives and industry best practices.
ERP Governance & Business Advocacy
  • Serve as the primary internal advocate during the implementation, representing business priorities and ensuring vendor recommendations align with organizational goals.
  • Evaluate solution options and provide recommendations that balance operational needs, system functionality, scalability, and long-term sustainability.
  • Drive process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives.
Testing & Quality Assurance
  • Develop and coordinate System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) strategies.
  • Validate business processes, system functionality, integrations, reporting, and data accuracy.
  • Manage issue resolution and support readiness activities prior to deployment.
Data Migration & Validation
  • Partner with business and technical teams to map legacy data into Dynamics 365.
  • Support data cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and migration activities.
  • Ensure data integrity throughout testing and production cutover phases.
Security & Compliance
  • Collaborate with IT and project teams to design and maintain security roles, permissions, and access controls.
  • Ensure appropriate segregation of duties and adherence to internal governance and compliance requirements.
Training, Adoption & Change Management
  • Create and maintain end-user training materials, procedures, and documentation.
  • Facilitate user training sessions and support organizational change management efforts.
  • Serve as a trusted resource for users before, during, and after implementation.
Post-Go-Live Support & Continuous Improvement
  • Act as the primary business SME for Dynamics 365 following implementation.
  • Partner with leadership and end users to identify enhancement opportunities, system optimizations, and future functionality improvements.
  • Support ongoing ERP maintenance, upgrades, and business process improvements.
Preferred Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX and/or Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O).
  • Proven experience supporting or leading ERP implementations, upgrades, or migrations.
  • Strong understanding of finance, accounting, supply chain, inventory, warehouse, and operational business processes.
  • Experience partnering with third-party ERP implementation consultants and system integrators.
  • Strong requirements gathering, business analysis, testing, and documentation skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Ability to bridge the gap between business users and technical teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Accounting, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.
Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is more than a Dynamics expert. They are a business-minded ERP professional who can challenge assumptions, influence decisions, and act as the organization's trusted advisor throughout the ERP journey. This person will help ensure the company maximizes its investment in Dynamics 365 while driving user adoption, operational efficiency, and long-term success.

job.title: R&D Technician FIB-SEM (ONSITE)
job.description:
R&D Technician FIB-SEM (ONSITE) needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Wilmington, DE.
  • Pay Rate: $28-31/hr
  • Shift: M-F 4:00 pm - 12:30 am (some flexibility may be available in daily start/finish times). Will be trained during daytime hours (~8:30 am - 5 pm) for the first three months.
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Operation of a focused-ion beam scanning electron microscope (FIB-SEM) in support of the Leveraged Analytical Sciences group.
  • The candidate will work under the direction of experienced scientists to provide analytical support for Research and Development (R&D), Technical Service and Development (TS&D), and Manufacturing.
  • Prepare samples for analysis, following established procedures using equipment such as mechanical polishers, plasma or sputter coaters, and FIB-SEM cross-section milling and lift-out procedures.
  • Perform FIB-SEM analyses including imaging, energy-dispersive x-ray spectroscopy (EDS), and electron backscattered diffraction (EBSD), and assess basic data quality.
  • Review and organize collected data for reporting to customers.
  • Perform routine instrument maintenance, following established procedures.
  • Dispose of laboratory waste according to established protocols.
  • Adhere to all safety protocols.

Required:
  • 1+ years of experience performing FIB-SEM analyses and x-ray spectroscopy in an R&D environment

Buyer (ONSITE) needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Austin, TX.
  • Pay Rate: $28-38/hr
  • ONSITE
What You’ll Be Doing:

• Negotiates pricing and other terms of purchase under supervision. Quotes materials; procures materials, components, equipment, and services at the lowest cost consistent with consideration of quality, reliability of source and urgency of need. Expedites and ensures the timely receipt of materials.
• Works with engineering and MPM or SCM to recommend new suppliers. Issues RFQs, analyzes proposals, negotiates prices and delivery, issues and/or adjusts purchase orders in a timely manner.

• Leads problem resolution for material related accounting and receiving issues

• Impacts a range of customer, operational, project or service activities within own team and other related teams; works within broad guidelines and policies
• Explains difficult or sensitive information; works to build consensus
• Motivation, initiative, collaboration, connectivity, and coaching

Required:

• Skilled in inventory management, procurement processes, data analysis, and supply chain processes
• Procurement software SAP/SCV/ARIBA
• Demonstrates conceptual and practical expertise in own discipline and basic knowledge of related disciplines
• Understanding of supply chain processes and purchasing strategies.
• Knowledge of inventory management and logistics.
• Familiarity with contract management and vendor relations.
• A bachelor's degree in business administration, supply chain management, or procurement is required.
• Strong communication skills to collaborate with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams.

job.title: Manufacturing Technician $1,000 Sign-on Bonus
job.description:
We have 18-month contract opportunities for Manufacturing or Electronic Technicians.

Pay Rate: $22.00 to $28.00/Hr.
Second Shift and Weekend Shifts offer shift differential.
Available Shifts: 1st Shift, 2nd Shift, and Weekend Shift

Bonus is for Intermediate Manufacturing (2 plus years) or Advanced Technicians (significant manufacturing experience)
Sign-On Bonus $1,000 after 100 Days worked 

Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience in a Manufacturing Technician or Engineering Technician role
  • High School Diploma or Associate Degree
  • Electrical and electronic troubleshooting skills
  • Manufacturing and assembly experience

Job Responsibilities:
  • Interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and verbal instructions to build, repair, and test electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies.
  • Perform electro-mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, repair, and testing.
  • Identify, diagnose, and correct assembly or equipment issues.
  • Conduct inspections and quality checks on components and finished products.
  • Utilize testing equipment including:
  • Electronic Measurement Devices
  • Leak detectors, Vacuum pumps, and Test fixtures.
  • Maintain accurate production, labor, and work-order records in computer systems.
  • Receive & audit parts to ensure availability & accuracy before assembly or repair.
  • Complete detailing and finishing activities on completed products.
  • Follow Safety procedures and properly use required PPE, tools, and equipment.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • May assist with software-related tasks, or equipment repairs as needed.

Physical & Environmental Requirements:
  • Standing and walking for extended periods
  • Working in confined spaces
  • Bending, kneeling, squatting, twisting, and reaching
  • Climbing stairs and ladders and lifting and moving materials
  • Distinguishing between colors
  • Working in a manufacturing environment with elevated noise levels
  • Using hand tools and power tools
  • Operating forklifts and other industrial equipment

This role may involve work in a cleanroom environment and may require the use of:
Coveralls, Hoods, Booties, Safety glasses, Gloves, Respirators, and Chemical Aprons.

job.title: Engineering Technician - Gloucester, MA
job.description:
I AM LOOKING FOR THE BEST OF THE BEST... AND YOU ARE ONE OF THEM!
Engineering Technician – Semiconductor Manufacturing
Applied Materials | Gloucester, Massachusetts
PAY RANGE: $30.00 - $32.00 PER HOUR (Depending on Experience)
Plus Applicable Shift Differentials Available Shifts 1rst Shift:  5:30 pm – 4:00 pm (Monday through Thursday)
2nd Shift: 3:45 PM – 2:15 AM | +10% Differential (Monday through Thursday)
3rd Shift: 7:30 PM – 6:00 AM + 13% Differential (Monday through Thursday)
4th Shift: 5:45 AM – 6:15 PM | +11% Differential (Friday, Saturday and Sunday) Why This Opportunity? Are you a hands-on Engineering Technician who thrives in a fast-paced semiconductor production environment? Do you enjoy building, testing, and troubleshooting complex electro-mechanical systems? This is an opportunity to work on advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment and support cutting-edge technology. Why Applied Materials?
  • Global leader in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and technology.
  • Technology that powers AI, smartphones, automotive systems, medical devices and next-generation innovation.
  • Strong history of contractor-to-permanent employee conversions.
  • Work directly with advanced semiconductor manufacturing systems.
  • Excellent career growth and advancement opportunities.
What You Will Do
  • Perform electro-mechanical testing, checkout, fabrication, modification, troubleshooting and assembly.
  • Build and support electronics, electro-mechanical systems, prototype models and specialized test equipment.
  • Troubleshoot component-level and system-level electrical and mechanical issues.
  • Support new system installs, NPI activities and field upgrades.
  • Work from schematics, diagrams, layouts and technical instructions.
  • Maintain logbooks, technical documentation and test procedures.
  • Perform electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, vacuum and process testing.
  • Generate quality notifications and complete rework based on test results.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives and engineering activities.
Required Technical Skills
  • Hands-on manufacturing or production experience.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, vacuum and process systems.
  • Experience with hand tools and power tools.
  • Ability to read schematics, assembly drawings and engineering documentation.
  • Experience with electrical test equipment, meters and diagnostic tools.
  • Knowledge of fiber-optic communications.
  • Ability to write technical reports and procedures.
  • Semiconductor manufacturing experience preferred.
Mechanical Skills Required
  • Strong build, assembly and fabrication skills with experience using precision measuring devices.
Nice To Have
  • Experience with PMAC motion control systems.
Why You Will Want This Role
  • Hands-on work with advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge technology and complex systems.
  • Opportunity to support engineering innovation and NPI efforts.
  • A role where your technical skills truly make an impact.
Why Work Through Yoh?
  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Life and Disability Insurance
  • Weekly Direct Deposit and ePayroll
  • Employee Discount Programs
  • Dedicated Yoh Support Team
A Personal Note From Patty Vogel I have recruited for Applied Materials for many years and have watched talented Engineering Technicians build exceptional careers. Many contractors have converted to permanent employees and advanced into technical and leadership positions. If you enjoy solving complex problems and working on high-tech equipment, I would love to speak with you. Apply Today! Patty Vogel

job.title: Senior Salesforce CRM Product Owner
job.description:
Senior Salesforce CRM Product Owner
Direct Hire
McKinney, TX (Hybrid)
 
Overview
Client confidential opportunity for a senior product leader to own and evolve a Salesforce CRM platform roadmap, partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to improve customer engagement, sales effectiveness, and measurable revenue outcomes.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Own the Salesforce CRM product roadmap, prioritizing enhancements that improve customer experience, sales productivity, and growth.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Service, and Operations leaders to gather requirements, align priorities, and translate needs into product initiatives and user stories.
  • Collaborate with architects and delivery teams to manage and execute the backlog, ensuring solutions deliver measurable business value.
  • Leverage customer data, analytics, and AI-driven insights to inform product strategy, drive adoption, and maximize ROI.
  • Lead platform governance, vendor management, and executive stakeholder communications to ensure scalability as the business grows.
 
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • 7+ years of product ownership/product management experience, including Salesforce/CRM platforms.
  • Proven success owning roadmaps and backlogs and delivering measurable outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of CRM strategy, customer data/intelligence, and value realization.
  • Experience establishing governance and prioritization across competing stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply AI-driven customer intelligence to improve strategy and customer outcomes.

job.title: Talent Operations Specialist
job.description:
Talent Operations Specialist
6 month contract
Fort Mill, SC (Hybrid)

Position Summary
The Talent Operations Specialist provides hands-on operational support across Talent Management and People initiatives, with an initial focus on Activating Our Hybrid Model (AOHM). This is an execution-focused role designed to provide additional capacity across People Leader resources, data review, employee communications and notifications, question and theme tracking, and other operational activities.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working with data and technology, and able to independently complete clearly defined assignments. This role works within established processes and guidance, identifies issues or discrepancies, and escalates matters requiring policy interpretation or decision-making.

Key Responsibilities
People Leader Resources & Content Support
Update, organize, review, and maintain People Leader resources, guides, FAQs, presentations, communications, and other supporting materials.
Review materials for accuracy, consistency, completeness, formatting, and usability.
Incorporate approved updates into existing resources and maintain current versions across designated platforms.
Support the development and maintenance of employee- and leader-facing communications and resources.
Compile questions and feedback received through the People Solution Center and other established channels.
Categorize recurring questions, issues, and themes to help identify areas requiring additional guidance or communication.
Maintain clear summaries of emerging themes and recurring questions.
Support updates to FAQs, leader resources, and other materials based on approved guidance.
Review employee and location information against established criteria, including location, distance, and average commute information.
Validate data for accuracy and completeness and identify discrepancies, exceptions, or records requiring additional review.
Prepare and quality-check information used to support employee notifications and other communications.
Partner with People teams to complete defined notification and operational activities.
Provide hands-on operational support across Talent Management and People initiatives as business needs evolve.
Provide additional capacity to the accommodations team during periods of increased volume, as needed.
Process, organize, review, and maintain information according to established processes and guidance.
Complete high-volume or time-sensitive assignments accurately and within established timelines.
Identify potential issues and escalate situations requiring additional judgment, policy interpretation, or decision-making.
Maintain assigned work products, documentation, trackers, issue logs, and action items as needed.
Monitor assigned deliverables and communicate potential risks, discrepancies, or delays.
Work with internal stakeholders to clarify requirements and complete defined work.
Create clear, professional documentation for various stakeholders.

Required Skills & Qualifications
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to review information, recognize patterns, and identify discrepancies.
Ability to accurately organize, review, and work with data and information.
Strong written communication, documentation, and proofreading skills.
Ability to manage multiple assignments and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to independently execute clearly defined assignments while recognizing when questions or issues should be escalated.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office/Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and Teams.
Ability to quickly learn new processes, systems, and technology.
Strong commitment to accuracy, confidentiality, and appropriate handling of employee information.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience.
Experience supporting Human Resources, Talent Management, People Operations, Employee Experience, or related business functions.
Experience reviewing, organizing, validating, or maintaining employee or business data.
Experience supporting programs, projects, communications, or operational initiatives.
Familiarity with SharePoint, Box, or similar content-management platforms.
Exposure to Microsoft Copilot, Box AI, or other AI-enabled productivity tools.
Financial services or other highly regulated industry experience is a plus.Talent Operations Specialist

job.title: Senior Azure .NET Developer
job.description:
Senior Azure .NET Developer
irving, TX (Hybrid)
Direct Hire

Position Summary
As an experienced Senior Software Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in driving the design, development, and implementation of robust, scalable, secure, and modern application architecture, with deep expertise in .NET, Azure technologies, and Azure Cosmos DB.
Beyond technical execution, this role calls for someone who takes full ownership and accountability for outcomes — running toward problems, especially in production, rather than waiting to be asked. You will understand enterprise requirements end-to-end and think several steps ahead to design solutions that stand the test of time. You will act as a hands-on architect and the team's go-to technical resource, reasoning through trade-offs with data and bringing well-communicated recommendations to the Senior Management and architecture team.
What This Role Requires
  • Hands-On Ownership: Personally designs, builds, reviews, troubleshoots, and supports critical components — this is a hands-on technical lead role, not a coordination-only architect position.
  • Decision-Ready Judgment: Frames problems with supporting data, weighs tradeoffs, and brings a clear recommended path with business and technical impact — not just options.
  • Go-To Resource: The person developers and stakeholders bring hard technical questions to — across Azure and C#/.NET — and trust to give a clear, confident answer.
  • Constructive Challenge: Pushes back constructively on weak assumptions and shortcuts, balancing delivery urgency with long-term maintainability.
  • Accountability: Owns outcomes beyond code complete: requirements clarity, dependencies, test readiness, release planning, observability, rollback, documentation, and hypercare.
  • Force Multiplier: Builds reusable patterns, standards, templates, and runbooks, and develops secondary ownership so critical knowledge is never a single point of failure.
  • AI-Forward: Actively explores, adopts, and introduces AI-driven SDLC practices — then drives their adoption across the team, validating all AI-generated output through rigorous human review and testing.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Requirements & End-to-End Ownership
  • Understand requirements in full enterprise context — source-of-truth decisions, upstream/downstream systems, business rules, data ownership, security, and support impact.
  • Lead technical discovery into solution designs, technical stories, acceptance criteria, dependency and data mappings, exception scenarios, estimates, risks, and implementation plans.
  • Own delivery from design through testing, deployment, production validation, support transition, and continuous improvement — escalating risks early with options and recommendations.
  • Assess scope changes for architecture, schedule, testing, data, dependency, and operational impact before committing.
Architecture & Technical Direction
  • Own Azure and C#/.NET architecture, implementation, and engineering standards, aligning key architecture decisions with the Senior Manager and architecture team.
  • Design cloud-native, API-led, event-driven, and data-integration solutions; document decisions, alternatives, and tradeoffs in language suited to developers, leadership, and business partners.
  • Evaluate scalability, security, resiliency, performance, observability, maintainability, cost, and supportability before implementation.
  • Mentor engineers through design and code reviews, pairing, and feedback; establish patterns for error handling, retries, idempotency, and reusable integration components.
Hands-On Engineering
  • Build industry-grade applications, APIs, microservices, and integrations using C#, .NET, and ASP.NET Core, engineered to meet sub-150ms API response targets.
  • Must have strong, hands-on expertise with Azure Event Hubs, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Data Factory (ADF), and Azure Cosmos DB.
  • Working knowledge of Azure Functions, App Service, Container Apps/AKS, API Management, Azure Front Door, Key Vault, Application Insights, and Azure DevOps.
  • Apply strong practices for asynchronous processing, concurrency, dependency injection, authentication/authorization, data modeling, API contracts, retries, circuit breakers, idempotency, and dead-letter recovery.
  • Front-end contribution (React.js, Next.js) as needed is a plus, not required — primary depth stays in backend and integration engineering.
Performance, Data & Cost Engineering
  • Diagnose end-to-end performance using correlated telemetry across edge, API, compute, messaging, database, and batch layers.
  • Use workload evidence — latency, throughput, error/retry rates, CPU/memory, Cosmos DB RU consumption and partitioning — to guide decisions rather than guesswork.
  • Tune Cosmos DB partitioning, throughput, and indexing; balance real-time and batch workloads without defaulting to capacity increases.
  • Evaluate Azure cost and capacity tradeoffs, and recommend savings without weakening reliability.
DevSecOps & Release Engineering
  • Champion automated unit, integration, contract, regression, and performance testing with meaningful coverage as part of CI/CD quality gates.
  • Build and improve Azure DevOps YAML pipelines, environment promotion, approvals, and reliable rollback strategies.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (Bicep or equivalent) for repeatable application and platform deployments.
  • Embed secure engineering practices: managed identity, secrets management, least privilege, and vulnerability remediation.
Observability, Reliability & Production Support
  • Design structured logging, correlation IDs, distributed tracing, metrics, and alerts that minimize noise and speed root-cause analysis.
  • Define production-readiness criteria, runbooks, failure modes, and post-deployment validation.
  • DR Champion: Own disaster recovery strategy end-to-end — RPO/RTO targets, failover, backup/restore, recovery automation, and periodic DR testing.
  • Lead complex incident investigation with urgency, converting lessons learned into durable engineering improvements.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation, remaining available to support production issues as needed.
AI-Enabled Engineering
  • Be a front-runner in adopting approved AI-assisted practices across the SDLC — planning, coding, testing, documentation, review, and troubleshooting.
  • Validate all AI-generated output through human review, automated testing, and security controls.
  • Build reusable prompts, repository instructions, and guardrails that capture team learning and promote consistent, secure AI usage.
  • Track and communicate AI's impact on delivery speed, quality, and incident resolution.
Collaboration & Communication
  • Partner with product, QA, security, infrastructure, data, support, and onshore/offshore engineering teams.
  • Lead with empathy and accountability: listen, explain reasoning, challenge respectfully, and follow through on commitments.
  • Provide concise, accurate status, risk, and completion updates, keeping delivery status current.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with strong depth in C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, and Azure backend/integration services.
  • Proven, end-to-end ownership of production Azure solutions — from requirements and architecture through deployment, observability, and support.
  • Demonstrated expertise with cloud-native applications, microservices, event-driven architecture, and distributed-system failure handling.
  • Strong, hands-on expertise with Azure Event Hubs, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Cosmos DB, including production troubleshooting and performance optimization.
  • Solid experience with automated testing, Azure DevOps CI/CD, Git, Infrastructure as Code, containers, and observability tooling.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor developers, conduct design/code reviews, communicate tradeoffs, and lead through ambiguity.
  • Practical, responsible experience using AI development tools, including output validation and data protection.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate; Azure Solutions Architect Expert strongly preferred.
  • Experience with disaster recovery, high-availability architecture, distributed tracing, and production on-call support.
  • Cosmos DB partitioning/RU optimization, Azure performance engineering, and FinOps practices.
  • Experience standardizing AI-assisted engineering workflows or reusable development automation.
  • Experience in retail, distribution, supply chain, or heavy-duty aftermarket domains.
Success Measures
  • Risks, dependencies, and non-functional requirements are surfaced before development and QA.
  • Solutions reach production with automated tests, observability, documented support ownership, and validated rollback/recovery.
  • Technical debt is prevented where practical, or explicitly documented and bounded when intentionally accepted.
  • Develops clean designs, and reusable engineering assets grow over time.
  • AI-assisted development shows measurable improvement while maintaining human validation and quality.

job.title: Research Associate I/II – Molecular Biology (RT-qPCR & Cell Culture)
job.description:
Research Associate I/II – Molecular Biology (RT-qPCR & Cell Culture)

Location: South San Francisco, CA (100% Onsite)
Pay Rate: $35–$45/hour W2, depending on experience
Employment Type: Full-Time, Contract-to-Hire (6–9 Months)

Yoh Life Sciences is seeking a hands-on Research Associate I/II to join a growing biotechnology company developing innovative therapies for age-related and chronic diseases.

This position is ideal for a molecular biologist with strong, practical experience performing RNA extraction, cDNA synthesis, and RT-qPCR for gene-expression analysis, including high-throughput 384-well plate workflows.

The team needs someone who can contribute immediately at the bench, independently execute established protocols, troubleshoot experimental issues, and consistently generate accurate, reproducible data.

You'll support early-stage drug discovery programs through molecular biology assays, mammalian cell culture, biomarker analysis, and ex vivo tissue research.

Both experienced Research Associates and exceptional early-career scientists with substantial hands-on laboratory experience are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently execute complete gene-expression analysis workflows, including RNA extraction from cells and tissues, RNA quality and concentration assessment, cDNA synthesis, RT-qPCR assay setup, and data analysis.
  • Prepare and run 384-well RT-qPCR plates, including accurate sample dispensing, multichannel pipetting, serial dilutions, appropriate assay controls, and reproducible plate preparation.
  • Analyze RT-qPCR results using appropriate reference genes, controls, and normalization methods; interpret experimental findings and identify technical or biological variability.
  • Troubleshoot assay performance issues, including inconsistent Ct values, contamination, poor RNA quality, amplification efficiency, and unexpected experimental results.
  • Perform Western blot, ELISA, and other molecular or protein-based assays, including sample preparation, protein quantification, and biomarker measurements.
  • Maintain mammalian cell cultures using aseptic techniques, including passaging, counting, thawing, cryopreservation, and routine culture maintenance.
  • Support ex vivo studies through tissue processing and primary cell isolation from rodent and/or human donor samples.
  • Execute established SOPs with precision, speed, and consistency while managing multiple experiments and competing research priorities.
  • Maintain accurate laboratory records, document experimental deviations, analyze results, and communicate findings clearly to research teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Biology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Cell Biology, or a related life science discipline.
  • Approximately 1–3+ years of substantial hands-on laboratory experience in academic or industry research. Exceptional early-career candidates with strong, repeated laboratory experience will be considered.
  • Direct, hands-on experience performing RNA extraction, cDNA synthesis, and RT-qPCR for gene-expression analysis, including assay preparation, controls, and interpretation of results.
  • Hands-on experience with 384-well qPCR plate workflows, including accurate pipetting, plate preparation, and consistent experimental execution.
  • Strong understanding of RT-qPCR principles, assay controls, normalization, data interpretation, and troubleshooting.
  • Excellent pipetting technique, including multichannel pipetting, serial dilutions, and high-throughput plate-based assays.
  • Hands-on experience with mammalian cell culture and aseptic techniques.
  • Experience performing Western blot and ELISA assays.
  • Experience with tissue processing and/or primary cell isolation from rodent or human samples.
  • Ability to independently execute established protocols, maintain detailed experimental documentation, and produce reproducible results with minimal supervision.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to explain experimental methods, results, and scientific conclusions.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or CRO industry experience, particularly in fast-paced research environments.
  • Experience performing repeated, high-volume RNA extraction and RT-qPCR experiments across multiple projects.
  • Experience with biomarker assays involving plasma, serum, tissue lysates, or cell culture samples.
  • Experience handling primary cells, human donor tissue, or rodent tissue.
  • Familiarity with automated liquid handling platforms and high-throughput molecular assay workflows.
  • Experience with GraphPad Prism, Excel, or electronic laboratory documentation systems.
  • Experience supporting translational research, pharmacodynamic studies, or early-stage drug discovery programs.


What We're Looking For

We're particularly interested in candidates who:

  • Have personally performed RNA extraction through RT-qPCR and gene-expression analysis on a regular basis—not simply supported or analyzed these workflows.
  • Are comfortable preparing and running 384-well qPCR assays with high accuracy and reproducibility.
  • Can explain why an assay works, what the controls demonstrate, and how experimental results support scientific conclusions.
  • Can troubleshoot technical problems independently rather than relying on extensive guidance.
  • Enjoy hands-on bench work and can maintain productivity across multiple concurrent experiments.
  • Can contribute quickly in a fast-paced research environment with minimal ramp-up time.


Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • Contribute directly to early-stage drug discovery programs focused on age-related and chronic diseases.
  • Work alongside experienced scientists in a collaborative, hands-on research environment.
  • Gain exposure to molecular assays, biomarker analysis, mammalian cell culture, and ex vivo research across multiple programs.
  • Opportunity for permanent conversion based on performance and business needs.


Additional Details

  • Full-time, 100% onsite in South San Francisco, CA.
  • Initial contract duration of approximately 6–9 months.
  • Occasional weekend cell culture maintenance may be required.
  • No live animal handling is required.
  • Final candidates will complete an onsite practical laboratory assessment to demonstrate technical proficiency.
  • Candidates should be prepared to discuss the scientific principles, controls, troubleshooting approaches, and results of assays they have personally performed.


Apply Today

If you have strong hands-on experience with RNA extraction, RT-qPCR gene-expression analysis, 384-well plate workflows, and mammalian cell culture, we'd like to hear from you.

Please submit an updated resume highlighting the molecular biology assays, plate formats, cell culture procedures, and tissue-based experiments you have personally performed.

Yoh, a Day & Zimmermann company, is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

job.title: Onsite Installation Project Manager
job.description:
Onsite Installation Project Manager
Direct Hire
North Phoenix (Onsite)
 
Summary
We’re seeking an Onsite Project Manager / Assistant Site Manager to lead the mechanical, electrical, and commissioning scope for AMHS (Automated Material Handling System) installation at customer facilities. This role owns day-to-day site execution—safety, schedule, quality, documentation, and stakeholder communication—through project closeout and handoff.
 
Responsibilities
  • Establish and enforce site-specific installation safety procedures.
  • Own safety execution on site; perform routine audits and support incident investigations.
  • De-escalate and resolve challenging situations with customers, contractors, and internal team members.
  • Drive safe, high-quality, on-time installation deliverables; supervise on-site personnel.
  • Review project schedules/milestones; build and maintain the installation working plan and schedule.
  • Coordinate on-site resource plans to meet project requirements.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for installation-related coordination with customer stakeholders.
  • Manage scope changes, corrective actions, and associated updates to plans and documentation.
  • Produce and distribute installation status reports.
  • Lead project closeout and support acceptance/handover by completing required installation documentation.
  • Create and maintain key site management documents (org chart, contact lists, etc.).
  • Identify and track risks impacting safety, quality, cost, and schedule.
  • Develop and manage the installation quality plan and document control plan.
  • Lead, coach, and develop internal and contractor teams to execute successfully on site.
  • Set expectations, roles, responsibilities, and communication cadence.
  • Coordinate training and team development to strengthen technical, safety, quality, and interpersonal capabilities.
 
Requirements
  • Associate’s degree (A.S.) in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering
  • 3+ years of semiconductor automation experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical procedures, professional publications, and regulations.
  • Strong report-writing and business communication skills; comfortable presenting to groups.
  • Strong project management and time management skills.
  • Mechanical/electrical background; able to use specialized installation tools as required.
  • Familiarity with operating and maintaining multiple AMHS-related systems, such as:
  • Stockers, conveyors, AGVs, and/or OHT systems
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (including Excel and MS Project).
  • Able to read equipment drawings and identify parts/components from drawings.
  • Safety-focused with excellent verbal and written communication.
  • Valid driver’s license and good driving record required.
  • Frequent hands-on activity (handling, reaching) and regular communication (talk/hear).
  • Occasional standing/walking/sitting/climbing/stooping/kneeling/crouching.
  • Regularly lift/move up to 25 lbs; occasionally up to 50 lbs.
  • Moderate noise environment typical of installation/industrial customer sites.

job.title: Semiconductor Manufacturing Tech ($1,000 Sign On Bonus)
job.description:
We have 18-month contract opportunities for Manufacturing Technicians in Austin Texas. These positions have a very real possibility to go temp to hire.

Sign-On Bonus is for intermediate and advanced candidate with multiple years of Manufacturing experience and/or in the Semiconductor industry.

Sign-On Bonus Structure: $1,000 after 100 Days worked

Entry Level Rate: $22/Hr.
Intermediate Rate: $25./Hr. (multiple years manufacturing experience)
Advanced Rate:
$28/Hr. (4+ years of experience in the semiconductor industry)

Second Shift and Weekend Shifts offer shift differential.
Available Shifts: 1st Shift, 2nd Shift, and Weekend Shift

Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience in a Manufacturing Technician or Engineering Technician role
  • High School Diploma or Associate Degree
  • Electrical and electronic troubleshooting skills
  • Manufacturing and assembly experience

Job Responsibilities:
  • Interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and verbal instructions to build, repair, and test electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies.
  • Perform electro-mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, repair, and testing.
  • Identify, diagnose, and correct assembly or equipment issues.
  • Conduct inspections and quality checks on components and finished products.
  • Utilize testing equipment including:
  • Electronic Measurement Devices
  • Leak detectors, Vacuum pumps, and Test fixtures.
  • Maintain accurate production, labor, and work-order records in computer systems.
  • Receive & audit parts to ensure availability & accuracy before assembly or repair.
  • Complete detailing and finishing activities on completed products.
  • Follow Safety procedures and properly use required PPE, tools, and equipment.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • May assist with software-related tasks, or equipment repairs as needed.

Physical & Environmental Requirements:
  • Standing and walking for extended periods
  • Working in confined spaces
  • Bending, kneeling, squatting, twisting, and reaching
  • Climbing stairs and ladders and lifting and moving materials
  • Distinguishing between colors
  • Working in a manufacturing environment with elevated noise levels
  • Using hand tools and power tools
  • Operating forklifts and other industrial equipment

This role may involve work in a cleanroom environment and may require the use of:
Coveralls, Hoods, Booties, Safety glasses, Gloves, Respirators, and Chemical Aprons.

job.description:
Buyer / Supply Chain Analyst
Applied Materials | 100% Onsite | 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM
Gloucester, MA
$33.45 per Hour
Yoh is partnering with Applied Materials, the world leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world, to identify a Buyer / Supply Chain Analyst for an exciting onsite opportunity in Gloucester, Massachusetts.
This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or early-career supply chain professional looking to build a long-term career with an industry-leading technology organization. You will work closely with suppliers, manufacturing teams, engineers, and program managers to ensure material availability, support production goals, and drive supply chain excellence.
Key Responsibilities
  • Ensure uninterrupted material supply to support manufacturing operations.
  • Follow up on purchase orders and supplier deliveries.
  • Partner with suppliers to manage demand and supply requirements.
  • Execute pull-ins and push-outs to align with MRP demand.
  • Resolve shipment, receiving, invoicing, and billing issues.
  • Support inventory reduction and Excess & Zero Demand (E&Z) initiatives.
  • Obtain and evaluate supplier quotations (RFQs).
  • Assist with supplier negotiations and cost management activities.
  • Drive resolution of supply-related issues with engineering, manufacturing, and program teams.
  • Maintain accurate purchasing records and adhere to standard business processes.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree required.
  • 1-2 years of related experience in Supply Chain, Purchasing, Procurement, Operations, Business, Logistics, or Manufacturing.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience working with data, reports, and problem-solving activities.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
Preferred Experience
  • Purchase Order (PO) Management
  • MRP Execution
  • Supplier Management
  • Inventory Management
  • RFQs and Vendor Quotes
  • Shortage Management
  • Dispute Resolution
  • Cost Reduction Initiatives
  • Supply Chain Analytics
Why Applied Materials?
Applied Materials is one of the most respected companies in the semiconductor industry, developing the technologies that enable the world's most advanced chips and electronics.   • Pay Rate: $33.45/hour

job.title: Client Service Associate
job.description:
Financial Client Service Associate
Position Summary:
We are seeking a Client Service Associate to join a professional financial services team and provide day-to-day support to advisors and their clients. This individual will help manage client requests, maintain account information, coordinate meetings, and assist with the administrative and operational needs of the office.

The successful candidate will be organized, responsive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a client-facing environment. Strong communication skills and a high degree of professionalism are essential.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients by responding to questions, requests, and account-related needs via phone, email, and in-person interactions.
  • Assist financial advisors with daily scheduling, including coordinating appointments, preparing materials, organizing client meetings, and completing post-meeting follow-up.
  • Handle a variety of account servicing activities, including new account setup, account transfers, beneficiary updates, required minimum distributions, address changes, and other client maintenance requests.
  • Keep client information and documentation current and accurate within internal CRM and account systems.
  • Follow established operational and regulatory procedures, including applicable FINRA and SEC requirements, while maintaining strict confidentiality of client and account information.
  • Communicate with third-party custodians, investment providers, financial institutions, and other external partners to facilitate transactions and resolve account-related issues.
  • Assist with general branch administration, including preparing documents, coordinating mail and correspondence, supporting client events and educational sessions, and assisting with newsletters or digital communications.
  • Contribute to a positive office environment by identifying opportunities to improve processes, enhance client service, and support the broader team.
Ideal Candidate:
We are looking for someone who takes ownership, works well with others, and genuinely enjoys helping people. The ideal candidate is comfortable in a fast-paced environment, approaches challenges with a solutions-oriented mindset, and consistently follows through on commitments.

Strong candidates will demonstrate sound judgment, integrity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn. We value individuals who take pride in their work, look for ways to improve the client experience, and contribute positively to a collaborative team environment.

Qualifications:
  • Ability to work on-site Monday through Friday.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to quickly learn and effectively navigate CRM and other business systems.
  • Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to prioritize competing responsibilities while working independently and as part of a team.
  • Professional demeanor with a high level of discretion, integrity, and confidentiality.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Associate's or bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Degree or educational background in finance, accounting, business, or a related field is a plus.
  • Previous experience in financial services, wealth management, banking, or a client-facing administrative environment is beneficial.

job.title: Cyber Security Architect
job.description:
Cyber Security Architect
12 month contract
Fort Mill, SC (Hybrid 2-3 days a week)
 
Cyber Security Architect focused on API Security Reviews
 
Job Overview:
Our Information Security team is seeking an exceptional Security Architect to engage in API project efforts in Cloud, On-prem and Data security architectures. As the Security Architect at our firm, you will work side by side with our Development, Operations, Business units, and Enterprise Architecture teams to ensure our environment is secured and monitored. The right person for this role will have a broad technical cloud security background with a focus on security design, detection, prevention, and response to security threats.
 
Responsibilities:
  • Secure APIs by implementing robust access control mechanisms, OAuth, JWT, and configuring API gateway security to ensure authenticated and authorized access.
  • Develop reusable security design patterns addressing common cybersecurity challenges, ensuring consistency and best practices across diverse technology stacks and business domains.
  • Craft clear, actionable security standards and policies, aligning them with industry best practices and regulatory requirements while ensuring adaptability to emerging technologies.
  • Lead the design and innovation of security architectures, integrating advanced technologies to protect against evolving threats while enabling business agility and growth.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders to align security initiatives with business objectives, ensuring broad support and integration at all levels.
  • Expertise in cybersecurity frameworks, network security, cloud security, identity management, and encryption, with proficiency in implementing zero-trust architectures and secure DevOps practices across diverse IT environments.
  • Threat modeling, risk assessment, and vulnerability management, coupled with experience in SIEM implementation, log analysis, and incident response in complex enterprise settings.
  • Conduct thorough threat analysis using intelligence and analytics to identify and mitigate potential security risks proactively, reducing business impact.
  • Implement and oversee a risk management framework, balancing security investments with business needs to protect assets while supporting growth and innovation.
  • Securing machine learning models against adversarial attacks, ensuring data privacy in AI training sets, and implementing ethical AI principles in security applications.

job.title: Sr. Project Manager/ Business Analyst- Data Engineering
job.description:
Job Title: Senior Project Manager/ Business Analyst
Location: New York, NY- Hybrid- 3 days onsite
Type:- Long term contract
Rate:- $75/hr -$90/hr - W2 ONLY


Key Responsibilities
Project Management and Delivery
  • Manage multiple concurrent initiatives from planning through execution
  • Build and maintain project plans, milestones, timelines, action trackers, and status reports.  Track deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, and decisions
  • Coordinate work across business, data, engineering, finance, risk, credit, and operations teams.  Follow up with owners and proactively remove blockers
  • Keep projects moving when priorities, scope, or requirements change
  • Provide clear updates to stakeholders and leadership

Business Analysis and Requirements

  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand their data and reporting needs
  • Gather, document, and organize business and technical requirements
  • Translate business needs into clear deliverables for data engineering teams
  • Help define project scope when the work is not fully structured
  • Document workflows, processes, data requirements, and expected outcomes
  • Support the creation of user stories, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and project materials
  • Ask the right questions to identify gaps, risks, and dependencies
Data Analysis and Technical Collaboration

  • Work directly with data and engineering teams supporting Metis and related data products
  • Use SQL to query and analyze data before presenting findings to project or business stakeholders
  • Develop a practical understanding of data sources, data flows, data quality, and reporting requirements
  • Review data issues and help determine the appropriate business or technical response
  • Participate in initiatives involving security data, client data, finance data, market data, performance data, governance, and master data management
  • Learn new platforms, tools, and processes as project needs evolve
Reporting and AI Enablement
  • Use Jira to manage work, track progress, and maintain project visibility
  • Produce reporting and communication materials for different stakeholder groups
  • Use AI tools to accelerate project reporting, documentation, analysis, requirements development, and stakeholder communication
  • Identify opportunities to improve how the team manages information and delivers work

Required Qualifications
  • Experience managing technology, data, or enterprise business initiatives
  • Strong hands on Project Management experience
  • Strong working knowledge of Jira
  • Experience gathering and documenting requirements
  • Ability to work with technical teams, including data engineering or software engineering groups
  • Practical SQL experience and the ability to perform basic data analysis
  • Experience within financial services or another complex data driven environment
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
