job.title: Automation Engineer
job.description:
Yoh is seeking a Laboratory Automation Engineer – NGS & Molecular Diagnostics to support a client in the South Bay Area, CA. This is a hands-on technical opportunity focused on developing, implementing, and optimizing automated laboratory workflows for cell-free DNA (cfDNA), low-input DNA, and next-generation sequencing applications.

The successful candidate will combine strong robotic liquid-handler programming skills with practical molecular biology and NGS experience. You will translate complex laboratory protocols into reliable automated methods, integrate laboratory instruments and software, troubleshoot workflow performance, and help establish scalable automation processes suitable for molecular diagnostic development.

This role is well suited for an automation specialist who can independently own projects from early method development through qualification, documentation, and transfer into routine laboratory operations. 

Department: Assay Development / Research & Development
Location: Sunnyvale, CA
Salary: $103,000-$165,000 (DOE)
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities:
 Development
  • Evaluate, configure, and implement laboratory automation platforms such as Hamilton Microlab STAR, Agilent Bravo, Beckman Coulter Biomek, or comparable liquid-handling systems.
  • Assess automation platform capabilities against assay requirements, throughput needs, workflow complexity, and future scalability.
  • Design robotic deck layouts, labware configurations, liquid classes, transfer parameters, and integrated workflows.
  • Coordinate instrument setup, commissioning, vendor support, and operational readiness.
  • Develop automation strategies that improve throughput, reproducibility, reagent utilization, and hands-on time.
Robotic Programming and Instrument Integration
  • Independently develop, debug, optimize, and maintain custom robotic methods using software such as Hamilton VENUS, Agilent VWorks, Beckman Biomek software, or equivalent programming environments.
  • Translate manual molecular biology protocols into reliable and executable automated workflows.
  • Develop custom routines for liquid transfers, reagent dispensing, magnetic-bead handling, incubation, thermal cycling, plate movement, and workflow-control logic.
  • Implement barcode-based sample identification, reagent tracking, operator alerts, error detection, and safe recovery procedures.
  • Integrate liquid handlers with supporting laboratory systems, including thermal cyclers, plate readers, barcode scanners, and laboratory information management systems.
  • Maintain version-controlled scripts, technical documentation, method specifications, and change histories.
  • Work with equipment vendors and internal technical teams to resolve complex automation, programming, and integration issues.
cfDNA and NGS Workflow Automation
  • Automate and optimize cfDNA, low-input DNA, and NGS library-preparation workflows.
  • Develop automated methods for processes such as magnetic-bead purification, DNA cleanup, end repair, adapter ligation, unique molecular identifier incorporation, amplification, target enrichment, and library normalization, as applicable.
  • Optimize liquid handling to minimize sample loss, improve transfer consistency, and control contamination and carryover.
  • Support samples with variable DNA concentrations and fragment-size distributions.
  • Work closely with assay development scientists and other technical partners to assess library quality, sequencing metrics, and overall workflow performance.
  • Investigate workflow failures and implement corrective actions that improve assay robustness, recovery, and reproducibility.
Method Development, Qualification, and Validation
  • Design and execute experiments comparing automated workflows with established manual or reference methods.
  • Establish and evaluate acceptance criteria for pipetting accuracy and precision, sample recovery, library yield, fragment-size distribution, contamination, carryover, and reproducibility.
  • Develop and execute instrument qualification, method verification, and performance-testing protocols.
  • Support analytical validation, method transfer, and process scale-up in collaboration with assay development, quality, laboratory operations, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Maintain clear records of development experiments, deviations, corrective actions, and method changes.
  • Develop and maintain automation workflows in alignment with applicable laboratory quality systems and regulatory requirements.
Troubleshooting and Operational Support
  • Perform root-cause analysis of robotic errors, liquid-handling failures, assay variability, and instrument-integration issues.
  • Optimize liquid classes, mixing parameters, aspiration and dispense settings, deck configurations, and error-handling logic.
  • Develop operating, preventive-maintenance, and troubleshooting procedures in partnership with equipment vendors.
  • Train laboratory personnel on routine operation, workflow execution, and error recovery.
  • Prepare technical documentation and provide ongoing support during transfer into routine laboratory use.
Requirments:
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in automation engineering, robotics, biomedical engineering, bioengineering, mechanical engineering, biotechnology, molecular biology, or a related discipline.
  • At least 3–5 years of hands-on experience developing and implementing laboratory automation workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience programming and debugging liquid-handling robots, preferably using Hamilton, Agilent Bravo, Beckman Coulter Biomek, or comparable platforms.
  • Proven ability to write custom automation scripts and translate laboratory protocols into automated methods.
  • Experience with NGS library preparation, molecular biology workflows, DNA purification, or related sample-preparation processes.
  • Strong understanding of liquid handling, magnetic-bead purification, reaction setup, thermal cycling, and multistep plate-based workflows.
  • Experience troubleshooting automation methods, liquid transfers, laboratory instruments, and integrated workflows.
  • Ability to independently drive automation projects from development through implementation.
  • Strong technical documentation, experimental-design, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with scientists, engineers, laboratory operations personnel, quality teams, software or LIMS partners, and equipment vendors.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with cfDNA, circulating tumor DNA, liquid biopsy, or other low-input DNA workflows.
  • Experience with targeted sequencing panels, hybrid-capture methods, UMI-based sequencing, or other highly sensitive molecular diagnostic applications.
  • Familiarity with Illumina-compatible library-preparation chemistry and sequencing workflows.
  • Experience with automation in clinical diagnostics, regulated laboratories, assay validation, or design-control environments.
  • Programming experience with Python, SQL, APIs, or related tools used for instrument integration, data processing, and LIMS connectivity.
  • Experience with low-volume liquid handling, liquid-class optimization, automated sample tracking, and contamination control.
  • Experience integrating laboratory automation with thermal cyclers, plate readers, barcode systems, robotic plate movement, or other supporting instrumentation.

#IND-SPG

job.title: Scientist III - Analytical Development
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Scientist III, Analytics – Product Development for our pharmaceutical client in Corona, CA. In this role, you will provide advanced analytical, quality, and laboratory support for pharmaceutical R&D programs focused on the development and approval of generic drug products for U.S. and international markets. The Scientist III will independently perform analytical testing, method development and validation, laboratory investigations, technical documentation, and regulatory support while collaborating with internal Product Development teams, CROs, and CMOs. The ideal candidate will bring extensive pharmaceutical R&D experience, strong analytical chemistry expertise, and a thorough understanding of FDA, ICH, cGMP, and cGLP requirements.

Industry: Pharmaceutical / Product Development
Location: Corona, CA
Compensation: 80k + ; based upon experience
Type: Direct Hire

Job Functions
  • Independently perform analytical testing with limited or no supervision and communicate results to management within established timelines.
  • Perform testing of raw materials, in-process samples, finished products, and stability samples using compendial and non-compendial methods.
  • Perform analytical method development, evaluation, validation, and verification utilizing HPLC, GC, and other laboratory techniques.
  • Conduct analytical testing using wet chemistry, spectrometry, chromatography, physical testing, and other applicable techniques.
  • Operate analytical instrumentation including HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, balances, and other laboratory equipment.
  • Accurately document all laboratory testing in accordance with Good Documentation Practices, company policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Write, review, and execute analytical study plans, protocols, and reports.
  • Develop and review method development, method validation, and technology transfer protocols and reports.
  • Author technical documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies, guidance documents, validation protocols, and method transfer documentation.
  • Review laboratory notebooks, instrument logbooks, calculations, and data entries for accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
  • Conduct thorough laboratory investigations of Out-of-Specification (OOS), Out-of-Trend (OOT), and other aberrant analytical results.
  • Determine root causes of laboratory investigations, develop and implement appropriate Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs), and prepare investigation reports.
  • Review Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) documentation and related analytical documents for regulatory submissions.
  • Perform gap assessments of CMC and analytical documentation and provide recommended courses of action to management.
  • Support cGMP, cGLP, and safety audits conducted by FDA, OSHA, client companies, and other regulatory organizations.
  • Maintain familiarity and compliance with applicable FDA, ICH, and other regulatory guidelines and requirements.
  • Perform preventive maintenance, calibration, and qualification of laboratory equipment and analytical instruments.
  • Maintain laboratory Quality Systems related to samples, standards, reagents, equipment qualification, preventive maintenance, periodic calibration, stability chambers, and controlled-environment storage cabinets.
  • Collaborate with internal Product Development teams, CROs, and CMOs to establish timelines, understand analytical work requests, identify and resolve issues, and communicate results.
  • Support study design and ensure analytical development and technology transfer activities are completed in accordance with regulatory requirements and established timelines.
  • Provide effective and timely analytical support for R&D activities associated with the development and approval of generic drug products for U.S. and international markets.
  • Prepare sample and standard reconciliation reports and other analytical reports as required.
  • Support QC data management activities, including data review and control charting.
  • Utilize Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and related applications for data analysis, technical documentation, and communication.
  • Maintain strict adherence to laboratory compliance and safety programs.
  • Maintain a clean and safe laboratory environment, including proper cleaning and storage of laboratory equipment and glassware.
  • Perform additional laboratory activities and responsibilities as assigned by management.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biological Sciences, or a related scientific discipline required.
  • Minimum of five (5) to ten (10) years of relevant Pharmaceutical R&D experience with demonstrated accomplishments.
  • Strong expertise in analytical chemistry principles, methodologies, and laboratory techniques.

job.title: Laboratory Technician II – Medical Devices (2nd Shift)
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Laboratory Technician II for our medical device manufacturing client. In this role, you will be responsible for performing laboratory testing, environmental monitoring, equipment calibration, and quality control activities to support manufacturing operations. The Laboratory Technician II will conduct chemical, biological, and physical testing of medical devices, support sterilization processes, maintain laboratory equipment and documentation, and ensure compliance with established quality and safety procedures. The ideal candidate will have hands-on laboratory experience within a medical device, pharmaceutical, or nutraceutical manufacturing environment, strong attention to detail, and the ability to maintain accurate and complete laboratory records.

Industry: Medical Device Manufacturing
Location: Santa Fe Springs, CA (100% Onsite)
Schedule: Second Shift, 2:40 PM–11:10 PM
Compensation: $25–$28/hr based upon experience
Type: Direct Hire

Job Functions
  • Perform routine laboratory testing, sampling, measuring, recording, and analysis of biological, chemical, and physical materials.
  • Calibrate laboratory testing equipment and maintain accurate equipment calibration and maintenance records.
  • Operate autoclave equipment to perform steam sterilization processes.
  • Conduct environmental monitoring of cleanroom facilities in accordance with established procedures.
  • Prepare and mix chemical solutions used in laboratory and manufacturing processes.
  • Perform daily Quality Control (QC) checks of in-process batch mixing and passivation chemistry.
  • Prepare materials and product loads for Ethylene Oxide (EO) and gamma sterilization.
  • Coordinate the submission of test samples to external laboratories and retrieve testing reports.
  • Perform analytical and microbiological testing of medical devices, including:
    • Total Organic Carbon (TOC)
    • pH testing
    • Optical Density (OD)
    • Osmolality
    • Viscosity
    • Bioburden
    • Bacterial Endotoxin Testing (BET)
  • Maintain laboratory supply inventory to ensure materials and equipment are available for testing activities.
  • Perform package visual inspections, seal strength testing, and package integrity testing.
  • Accurately document laboratory testing results, equipment maintenance, and Quality Control activities in accordance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP).
  • Ensure laboratory records are complete, accurate, legible, and maintained according to established procedures.
  • Read and interpret technical drawings, written instructions, and laboratory procedures.
  • Communicate effectively with supervisors and team members, follow instructions carefully, and escalate unexpected testing results or laboratory issues as appropriate.
  • Ensure laboratory activities are performed according to established procedures and health and safety guidelines.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory work environment.
  • Comply with all company policies, procedures, safety regulations, and Quality System requirements.
  • Understand and adhere to the company's Quality Policy.

Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Education and experience commensurate with the responsibilities of the position.
  • Minimum of one (1) to three (3) years of laboratory experience within the nutraceutical, medical device, or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Experience performing laboratory testing, Quality Control inspections, and analytical measurements.
  • Familiarity with laboratory equipment calibration, preventive maintenance, and documentation.
  • Experience with chemical preparation, environmental monitoring, or sterilization processes.
  • Familiarity with laboratory testing techniques such as TOC, pH, optical density, osmolality, viscosity, bioburden, or bacterial endotoxin testing.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical drawings, written instructions, procedures, and laboratory documentation.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain complete, accurate, and legible testing results, measurements, and laboratory records.
  • Understanding of Good Documentation Practices (GDP), laboratory SOPs, and quality system requirements.
  • Basic mathematical skills, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, percentages, and accurate material counts.
  • Ability to interpret and follow written, verbal, and diagram-based instructions.
  • Effective verbal communication and active listening skills, with the ability to follow directions and respond to questions from supervisors and management.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to maintain laboratory supplies, equipment, and documentation.
  • Ability to perform assigned laboratory tasks while following established quality and safety procedures.

Physical Job Requirements
  • Laboratory, cleanroom, and medical device manufacturing environment.
  • Occasionally required to stand, walk, reach with hands and arms, talk, and hear while performing laboratory activities.
  • Ability to occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Regular handling of laboratory samples, chemicals, glassware, and testing equipment in accordance with established safety procedures.
  • Must be able to follow applicable laboratory safety, cleanroom, and manufacturing procedures.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

job.title: Portfolio Director
job.description:
*** THIS ROLEIS NOT OPEN TO 3RD PARTY CANDIDATES - PLEASE DO NOT APPLY ***

General Account of Position
The Director of Portfolio leads the Portfolio Office, accountable for what enters the delivery system, how it is routed, and whether it delivers value. This role consolidates the portfolio management, intake, resourcing, budgeting, enterprise status reporting, procurement, and vendor and contract management accountabilities previously held at the AVP, IT Service Delivery level, and the demand-shaping and resourcing accountabilities of the Director of Project Solutions and Delivery role, into a single director-level owner sized for an AI-first delivery model.
This position carries a distinctive early-tenure design mandate. The Director manages the current Business Analyst and Project Manager staff - both consultants and FTEs - and is accountable, in partnership with the CIO, to determine and recommend the long-term shape of the function. This includes: (1) evaluating the enterprise need for pre-SDLC business support and organizational project management assistance outside the SDLC - work that has fallen to IT in recent years[GH1]  - and recommending whether, and where, it should be staffed long term, within IT or elsewhere in the organization; (2) determining what FTE roles the Portfolio Office requires long term; and (3) determining the pace and sequencing of the consultant drawdown based on company need and efficiencies gained through the AI-first operating model. The Director's recommendations, developed with and approved by the CIO, will define the end-state design of this function.
In SDLC 2.0, heavy project management overhead is replaced by lane-based routing and evidence-based gates. The Portfolio Office operates the spec-intake front door in partnership with Product Engineering, routes work into the three-lane model at the appropriate risk tier, owns the confounder register as a managed portfolio asset, and gives the CIO and executive leadership a single, truthful view of demand, capacity, spend, and outcomes.

Essential Responsibilities
  1. Manage the current Business Analyst and Project Manager staff, both consultants and FTEs, including work assignment, performance management, development, and (for consultants) engagement oversight.
  2. Evaluate and recommend to the CIO, on the basis of evidence gathered in role, the long-term staffing design of the Portfolio Office: which FTE roles are required, which functions should be delivered through automation or AI-enabled workflows, and the disposition of each consultant seat.
  3. Assess the enterprise demand for pre-SDLC business support (business case shaping, requirements maturation, process analysis) and for organizational project management assistance on initiatives outside the SDLC; quantify this demand, determine whether it is appropriately an IT accountability long term, and recommend a staffing and placement model to the CIO.
  4. Own the consultant drawdown for portfolio, business analysis, and project management seats: define capability and efficiency milestones that gate each reduction, track run-rate against the target end-state, and sequence reductions based on company need rather than a fixed calendar.
  5. Own portfolio intake and demand management, operating the spec-intake front door and ensuring every initiative enters with a clear owner, outcome, and risk tier.
  6. Route work into the three-lane delivery model in partnership with the engineering Directors, monitoring lane capacity and rebalancing as priorities shift.
  7. Own and maintain the confounder register as a managed portfolio asset, ensuring cross-initiative dependencies, assumptions, and interference risks are visible and actively managed.
  8. Maintain the current portfolio of IT projects, vendors, and assets, including day-to-day IT budget tracking and the monthly enterprise status reporting process.
  9. Own IT budget management across OPEX and CAPEX for shared services and the portfolio, including forecasting, variance analysis, and capitalization treatment.
  10. Manage enterprise contracts, renewals, and terminations; maintain the contract repository and renewal calendar; recommend consolidations that reduce operational cost and support burden, including execution of the software portfolio rationalization savings targets. (Third-party risk accountability for these vendors resides with the Director, Security & Governance; this position owns the commercial and lifecycle dimensions.)
  11. Own IT procurement governance, including purchase intake, approval workflow, and alignment of purchases to architecture and security standards.
  12. Own vendor management discipline on the commercial and performance dimensions: performance scorecards, relationship cadence, and escalation for strategic vendors, in partnership with the accountable tower Directors and with risk input from Security & Governance.
  13. Provide benefits realization and outcome reporting, connecting delivered work to business value for the CIO, Executive Committee, and Board materials.
  14. Meet regularly with business owners to ensure roadmaps remain on track, documenting changes and feeding them back into intake and routing.
  15. Perform employee evaluations and reviews for direct reports, documenting as necessary.
Transition (Bridge) Responsibilities 
  1. Take documented handoff of portfolio, budgeting, enterprise status reporting, procurement, and contract management practices previously governed at the AVP, IT Service Delivery level, verifying signature authority and renewal calendars have no gaps.
  2. Assume management of the existing Business Analyst and Project Manager staff (consultants and FTEs) carried over from the Project Solutions and Delivery function, establishing a current-state baseline of work types, demand sources, and effort allocation within the first 90 days.
  3. Deliver to the CIO, within the first two quarters, a function design recommendation covering: long-term FTE roles for the Portfolio Office; the disposition and sequencing of each consultant seat with capability/efficiency gate criteria; and a recommendation on whether pre-SDLC business support and non-SDLC organizational project management should be staffed within IT, elsewhere in the organization, or wound down.
  4. Stand up the confounder register and lane-capacity reporting as standing portfolio artifacts within the first 90 days.
Other Responsibilities
  1. Proactively manage the supply and demand of IT services across the portfolio.
  2. Support audit requests related to procurement, contracts, and portfolio controls.
  3. Other duties as assigned.
Required Competencies
  1. Portfolio and Financial Management
  2. Organizational Design and Workforce Planning
  3. Business Analysis
  4. Decision Making
  5. Communication
  6. Relationship Building
  7. Prioritization and Time Management
  8. Enterprise Perspective
  9. Vendor and Contract Management
  10. Leadership
  11. Strive to reflect our five cultural values in all efforts: Put the Customer First, Do What You Say, Work Together, Be Innovative and Do the Right Thing.
Education and Experience
  1. Bachelor's degree required.
  2. Minimum 8 years of IT portfolio, program, or project management experience.
  3. Minimum 3 years of management experience, including management of blended consultant/FTE teams.
  4. Demonstrated experience with IT budgeting (OPEX/CAPEX), vendor and contract management, and executive reporting.
  5. Demonstrated experience designing or restructuring a function, including workforce planning and consultant transition, strongly preferred.
  6. Experience with lean/flow-based delivery models and AI-enabled/startup delivery environments preferred; business analysis background a plus.
Special Working Conditions and Physical Demands
  1. Non-traditional work hours may be required on an emergency, pre-scheduled, or project basis.
  2. Be able to support multiple business locations, either remotely or in person as needed.
Organizational Relationships
  1. This position reports to the SVP & Chief Information Officer.
  2. Business Analysts and Project Managers (consultants and FTEs), and portfolio and procurement coordination staff, report to this position.
  3. This position is accountable, jointly with the CIO, for recommending the long-term design of the Portfolio Office, including FTE roles, consultant drawdown, and the placement of pre-SDLC and non-SDLC support functions.
  4. This position partners closely with all tower Directors and the VP, Product & Platform Engineering.

job.title: Senior Angular UI Developer
job.description:
Job Title: Senior Angular UI Developer
Location: Jersey City, NJ - 3 days onsite
Type: Full Time
Salary: $150000/yr - $175000/yr


Our client is a mission-driven financial institution that enables access to capital for agriculture and rural America. Through the issuance of debt securities and the delivery of critical financial and technology services, the Corporation provides dependable credit and financial services nationwide.
 
About the Role: Seeking a hands-on Senior Angular UI Developer to build secure, responsive, and accessible enterprise web applications. This individual contributor will collaborate with Product, UX, Architecture, QA, and backend teams to deliver intuitive user experiences using Angular, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.

The developer will build and enhance applications that support the Funding Corporation’s financial and operational processes. The primary users are internal and external business and technology teams, and the applications support critical workflows related to debt issuance, funding operations, and enterprise services.

The successful candidate will contribute to the modernization of established enterprise applications, with an initial focus on strengthening secure, reusable Angular architecture and improving critical financial and operational workflows. The current front-end environment includes Angular-based applications integrated with enterprise services, and the team’s near-term goals include delivering production-ready features, improving performance and accessibility, and expanding consistent engineering standards across the platform.
Key Responsibilities

Application Development
  • Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise single-page applications using Angular 16+ and TypeScript, including standalone components, services, guards, interceptors, and reusable UI modules.
Enterprise UI Architecture
  • Define scalable front-end patterns for routing, forms, state management, API integration, and component composition while contributing to architectural decisions and technical standards.
Data & Grid Development
  • Build and optimize AG Grid Enterprise solutions for large datasets, including filtering, editing, validation, exports, and real-time updates.
API & Service Integration
  • Integrate REST APIs using typed request and response models, reusable service abstractions, and centralized error handling, logging, and retry patterns.
Authentication & Authorization
  • Implement secure Keycloak authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, RBAC, route and permission guards, token refresh, session management, and cross-tab logout handling.
State Management
  • Build maintainable reactive state solutions using Angular Signals, RxJS, Observables, and BehaviorSubjects, with attention to performance and scalability.
Forms & Validation
  • Build accessible, dynamic forms with reusable validation, conditional logic, and Reactive Forms; use Template-Driven Forms where appropriate.
Real-Time Communications
  • Develop responsive, event-driven interfaces using STOMP, WebSockets, SharedWorker, and cross-tab communication patterns.
  Requirements Qualification & Experience
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of professional front-end development experience, including at least 5 years building enterprise applications with Angular.
  • Experience building customer-facing applications supporting critical business operations.
Technical Skills
  • Required technical skills include Angular 16+, TypeScript, JavaScript ES6+, HTML5, SCSS/CSS3, Angular Material and CDK, RxJS, REST API integration, Git, automated testing, and secure authentication using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and RBAC. Experience with Angular 20, AG Grid Enterprise, and Keycloak is preferred.
Soft skills:
  • Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, with experience working in Agile delivery teams. Financial services or capital markets experience is a plus.

The team is looking to add a Level 2/Level 3 Desktop Support Engineerto support a rapidly growing user base that has more than doubled over the past year.
The role is heavily focused on supporting Windows 11 laptops, Citrix-hosted VDI, Microsoft Intune, and Microsoft 365.

The individual will serve as the primary point of contact for endpoint issues, troubleshoot problems, perform deployments, onboard and offboard users, and escalate infrastructure issues to specialized teams when necessary.

  • Strong experience supporting Windows 11 desktops and laptops.

  • Maintain meticulous records of samples and reagents inventory  
  • Record detailed, accurate experimental protocols and procedures in the laboratory notebook

  • Minimum 1 year experience in ex vivo tissue sample preparation and analyses

job.title: Cloud Architect – Microsoft Azure & Google Cloud
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for a Cloud Architect – Microsoft Azure & Google Cloud to join a growing enterprise organization modernizing its infrastructure and expanding its cloud capabilities. This is a hands-on architecture role responsible for developing cloud strategy, establishing technical standards, guiding implementations, and helping the organization transition from on-premises infrastructure to a secure multi-cloud environment.

The ideal candidate will be strongest in Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365, with meaningful experience across Google Cloud, identity, security, governance, enterprise applications, and cloud modernization.

Title: Cloud Architect – Microsoft Azure & Google Cloud
Compensation: $230,000–$280,000 base salary + bonus
Type: Direct Hire
Location: Remote or hybrid; Southern California and West Coast candidates preferred
Travel: Occasional travel to regional offices
Industry: Financial Services / Data Center

Responsibilities
  • Develop and execute cloud architecture strategies across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud.

  • Establish standards for cloud governance, security, identity, networking, monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and application hosting.

  • Design and manage Azure subscriptions, resource groups, policies, landing zones, networking, and identity services.

  • Establish Google Cloud organizational structures, IAM, organization policies, networking, billing, and hosting standards.

  • Lead Microsoft 365 architecture and security initiatives, including Entra ID, Conditional Access, Defender, Purview, and Intune.

  • Develop a roadmap for transitioning workloads from on-premises infrastructure to cloud platforms.

  • Provide architecture and implementation guidance for new cloud-based and AI-assisted applications.

  • Support enterprise application, ERP, and Dynamics 365 hosting or integration initiatives.

  • Define best practices for SSO, identity and access management, secrets management, monitoring, patching, and compliance.

  • Evaluate technical designs and remain hands-on during implementation, troubleshooting, and proof-of-concept work.

  • Partner with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, secure cloud solutions.

  • Serve as a senior technical resource and help guide, mentor, and cross-train infrastructure engineers.

  • Drive innovation and make recommendations regarding future cloud capabilities and platform investments.

Qualifications
  • 8+ years of experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure engineering, or enterprise technology.

  • Deep hands-on experience designing and implementing Microsoft Azure environments.

  • Strong Microsoft 365 architecture and security experience, including Entra ID, Conditional Access, Defender, Purview, and Intune.

  • Meaningful experience with Google Cloud Platform and Google Workspace.

  • Strong knowledge of cloud networking, identity, governance, security, monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and migration planning.

  • Experience with Azure Arc, hybrid-cloud environments, patching, and enterprise infrastructure modernization.

  • Experience supporting ERP platforms, enterprise applications, or Dynamics 365 is preferred.

  • Experience working with AI-assisted application development or helping business teams adopt AI-enabled solutions is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable being hands-on and implementing solutions rather than focusing exclusively on strategy or documentation.

  • Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Able to work independently, challenge assumptions, and provide direction in a lean, growing organization.

job.title: Research Associate I – Vector Engineering
job.description:
Yoh is seeking a motivated Research Associate I to join our biotechnology client's Vector Engineering team in South San Francisco, CA.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career scientist to gain hands-on experience in viral vector production, cell culture, and molecular biology while contributing to innovative therapeutic discovery programs.

Research Associate I | Vector Engineering

Location: South San Francisco, CA
Job Type: Contract to Hire
Pay Rate: $28–38/hr DOE
Schedule: Onsite, Full Time M–F

Position Overview
The ideal candidate will have strong laboratory fundamentals, exceptional attention to detail, and a demonstrated ability to learn quickly in a collaborative, fast-paced research environment. Our client values individuals who demonstrate initiative, high productivity, strong execution, and the potential to take on increasing responsibility.

Key Responsibilities
  • Support the production of adeno-associated viral (AAV) vectors for research and drug discovery.
  • Perform routine mammalian cell culture activities, including media preparation, cell maintenance, and passaging.
  • Learn and execute transfection, viral vector harvest, and purification workflows.
  • Execute established laboratory protocols and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Maintain accurate laboratory documentation and sample tracking.
  • Support reagent preparation, inventory management, and laboratory organization.
  • Collaborate with scientists and research associates to troubleshoot technical challenges.
  • Identify opportunities to improve laboratory workflows and processes.

Required Qualifications
  • Educational background in Biology, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Hands-on laboratory experience through academic research or industry.
  • Experience with serological pipetting and performing accurate serial dilutions.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow laboratory protocols.
  • Excellent organizational, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated initiative, productivity, and ability to manage multiple responsibilities.
  • Willingness to learn new techniques, take ownership of responsibilities, and develop independent laboratory skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with mammalian cell culture, particularly HEK293 cells.
  • Familiarity with transfection techniques.
  • Exposure to AAV, lentiviral vectors, or gene therapy research.
  • Experience with qPCR, Western blotting, or SDS-PAGE.
  • Familiarity with purification methods such as FPLC, TFF, depth filtration, or ultracentrifugation.
  • Previous experience in a biotechnology startup or fast-paced research laboratory.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique?
  • Work alongside experienced scientists developing innovative therapeutic technologies.
  • Gain hands-on experience with AAV production and advanced molecular biology techniques.
  • Join a growing biotechnology organization with opportunities for professional development.
  • Receive training and mentorship to expand technical capabilities.
  • Potential for long-term employment and internal career advancement.

If you are an ambitious early-career Research Associate with strong laboratory fundamentals, a demonstrated record of accomplishment, and a passion for biotechnology, we encourage you to apply.

Yoh is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics.

#IND-SPG

job.title: 3rd Shift Registered Nurse - Occupational Health
job.description:
Occupational Health Registered Nurses needed for 3rd shift contract opportunities with Yoh's manufacturing client in Arlington, TX. Two openings available!
 
  • Opening #1: Full-time, Sunday-Thursday for approximately 3 months, then transitions to per-diem
  • Opening #2: Two Fridays per month plus additional per diem coverage as needed (minimum commitment of 4 shifts/month)

This role is primarily focused on occupational health administration, compliance reporting, and case documentation, with limited direct patient care. The RN will support employee health services while managing OSHA records, workers' compensation documentation, health surveillance records, and corporate reporting requirements.


3rd Shift: 10:00PM - 6:30AM (Sundays 9:00PM - 6:30AM)
* Flexibility for occasional earlier or later start/end times is required to support shift changes.
* Must be able to complete 5 days of daytime orientation prior to working independently on 3rd shift. Orientation is typically 6:00AM - 2:30PM, with EMR training from 7:00AM - 3:30PM.

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Active/unrestricted Texas RN license
  • 3+ years of nursing experience in Occupational Health, Employee Health, Urgent Care, Emergency Medicine, Family Practice, Corrections, School Nursing, or similar settings
  • Strong organizational, time-management, and documentation skills
  • Self-motivated who can adapt to changing priorities and maintain a positive attitude in a fast-paced setting
  • Proficiency with EMR systems and electronic documentation
  • Professional, dependable, and customer-service focused

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Assess, triage, treat, and educate employees with work-related or non-work-related health concerns
  • Provide first aid and episodic treatment within established standing orders
  • Manage OSHA records, workers' compensation documentation, and health surveillance reporting
  • Perform occupational health screenings including drug testing, vision testing, pulmonary function testing, and biometric screenings

job.title: Senior Scientist – Pharmaceutical Formulation & Process Development
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring a Senior Scientist – Pharmaceutical Formulation & Process Development for a direct-hire opportunity with a pharmaceutical manufacturing organization in Rosenberg, TX (Greater Houston).

This is a senior-level, hands-on individual contributor position focused on pharmaceutical formulation and process development, experimental execution, scale-up, troubleshooting, and technology transfer. The ideal candidate will bring significant pharmaceutical-industry experience and the ability to personally translate product-development objectives into scientifically sound experiments, robust manufacturing processes, and successful scale-up and technology-transfer activities.

Title: Senior Scientist – Pharmaceutical Formulation & Process Development
Employment Type: Direct Hire
Salary: $105,000–$120,000/year
Location: Rosenberg, TX – Greater Houston
Schedule: Monday–Friday, approximately 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
Work Arrangement: Fully onsite

Limited relocation assistance may be available in the form of a sign-on bonus for qualified candidates.

Position Summary
Working under the direction of the Director of Research and Development, the Senior Scientist will personally design and execute formulation and process-development studies from laboratory scale through pilot, engineering, technology-transfer, and manufacturing activities.

The position requires a strong and consistent presence in the laboratory and pilot-plant environment. This is not a people-management or primarily administrative role. The Senior Scientist is expected to remain technically hands-on while serving as a senior scientific resource to other members of the R&D organization.

The role may support pharmaceutical finished-dosage-form programs including oral products, liquids, semi-solids, and suppository/pessary products, as applicable, across cosmetic, 510(k), ANDA, NDA, and other development programs.

Responsibilities
  • Design and personally execute pharmaceutical formulation and process-development experiments.
  • Develop and optimize finished drug-product formulations and manufacturing processes.
  • Evaluate API and excipient properties, compatibility, formulation robustness, and product performance.
  • Design scientifically sound experimental plans based on product objectives and development risks.
  • Generate, analyze, and interpret experimental data and recommend scientifically justified next steps.
  • Apply Quality by Design (QbD) and Design of Experiments (DOE) principles to formulation and process development.
  • Identify and evaluate Critical Quality Attributes (CQAs), Critical Material Attributes (CMAs), and Critical Process Parameters (CPPs).
  • Perform process optimization, characterization, scale-up, and technology-transfer activities.
  • Translate laboratory processes into robust pilot-scale and commercial manufacturing processes.
  • Evaluate manufacturing variables including mixing, shear, homogenization, temperature, order of addition, processing time, hold time, transfer, and filling parameters.
  • Troubleshoot formulation, process, scale-up, and manufacturing issues through experimentation and root-cause analysis.
  • Provide hands-on technical support during pilot, engineering, scale-up, registration, validation, technology-transfer, and manufacturing activities.
  • Support investigations involving process deviations, product-performance issues, and manufacturing challenges.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Engineering, Analytical Development, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Project Management.
  • Prepare and maintain laboratory notebooks, protocols, batch documentation, experimental records, technical reports, and development summaries.
  • Operate appropriate laboratory and pilot-scale pharmaceutical processing equipment.
  • Support technical-transfer documentation and manufacturing implementation.
  • Serve as a senior technical resource and mentor scientists and laboratory technicians without formal personnel-management responsibility.
  • Manage multiple technical assignments while maintaining ownership of quality, documentation, and timelines.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
  • PhD required in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related scientific or engineering discipline.
  • Minimum of seven years of relevant pharmaceutical-industry development experience required.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in pharmaceutical formulation development and process development required.
  • Demonstrated experience taking pharmaceutical products or processes from laboratory development through scale-up, pilot, engineering, GMP manufacturing, and/or commercialization.
  • Strong experience with pharmaceutical process optimization, process characterization, troubleshooting, and technology transfer.
  • Advanced knowledge of QbD, DOE, CQAs, CMAs, CPPs, process robustness, and pharmaceutical manufacturing principles.
  • Experience with oral dosage forms, oral liquids, liquid formulations, semi-solids, and/or suppository/pessary products preferred.
  • Experience supporting ANDA, NDA, 505(b)(2), 510(k), cosmetic, or other regulated product-development programs preferred.
  • Experience with engineering batches, registration batches, validation/PPQ activities, or commercial manufacturing support preferred.
  • CDMO or other fast-paced, multi-project pharmaceutical-development experience is highly desirable.
  • Strong experimental-design, data-analysis, troubleshooting, and root-cause-analysis capabilities.
  • Ability to independently execute complex technical assignments and translate laboratory findings into practical manufacturing recommendations.
  • Strong scientific judgment, technical writing, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple development programs and collaborate across technical and business functions.

job.title: Scientist / Senior Scientist
job.description:
Yoh is seeking a Senior Scientist, Analytical Validation – NGS & Molecular Diagnostics for an exciting opportunity with an innovative biotechnology client in the South Bay Area.

This role will be responsible for designing, executing, analyzing, and documenting analytical validation studies supporting advanced molecular diagnostic and next-generation sequencing (NGS) assays. The successful candidate will play a key role in establishing assay performance, reproducibility, robustness, and readiness for future clinical and regulatory milestones.

We are looking for a scientist who combines strong molecular biology expertise with analytical rigor, statistical thinking, and hands-on experience in cell-free nucleic acid workflows, NGS technologies, and regulated assay development environments.

Department: Assay Development / Research & Development
Location: Sunnyvale, CA
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: $160,000 - $220,000 (DOE)

Responsibilities:

Analytical Validation Strategy & Execution
  • Design and execute analytical validation studies for molecular diagnostic assays and NGS-based testing platforms.
  • Develop scientifically sound study designs, acceptance criteria, sample size calculations, and statistical analysis plans.
  • Lead studies evaluating:
    • Limit of Blank (LoB), Limit of Detection (LoD), and Limit of Quantitation (LoQ), as applicable
    • Analytical sensitivity and specificity
    • Repeatability and reproducibility
    • Operator, instrument, reagent lot, and workflow variability
    • Method comparison and analytical agreement
    • Interference, contamination, carryover, and assay robustness
    • Specimen and reagent stability
  • Identify assay failure modes and implement corrective actions to improve performance and reliability.
Molecular Biology & NGS Assay Development
  • Perform and optimize workflows involving plasma processing, cell-free nucleic acid extraction, quantification, and quality assessment.
  • Execute NGS library preparation workflows including:
    • End repair
    • Adapter ligation
    • Indexing
    • Amplification
    • Target enrichment
    • Library quality control
  • Evaluate the impact of DNA input quantity, library efficiency, sequencing depth, and molecular background noise on assay performance.
  • Develop and qualify controls, reference materials, and test specimens for validation studies.
  • Support characterization of low-abundance molecular signals and assay sensitivity limits.
NGS Data Analysis & Performance Assessment
  • Operate and troubleshoot NGS instrumentation and associated workflows.
  • Analyze sequencing and library quality metrics, including:
    • Read depth
    • Coverage uniformity
    • Mapping performance
    • Library complexity
    • Duplication rates
    • On-target performance
  • Collaborate with bioinformatics teams to evaluate analytical pipeline performance and quality-control thresholds.
  • Perform statistical analyses using tools such as R, Python, JMP, SAS, or equivalent platforms.
  • Generate technical summaries, validation reports, and performance assessments.
Automation & Workflow Optimization
  • Partner with automation engineers to transfer molecular workflows onto automated liquid-handling platforms.
  • Evaluate variability introduced by automation and support workflow qualification activities.
  • Assess contamination control strategies, sample tracking systems, and recovery procedures.
  • Support high-throughput laboratory process development and operational scale-up.
  • Contribute to SOP development, troubleshooting guides, and workflow documentation.
Quality & Regulatory Support
  • Author validation protocols, reports, deviation investigations, and technical documentation.
  • Maintain traceable documentation for samples, instrumentation, reagents, software, and analytical methods.
  • Support quality-system initiatives and documentation practices consistent with regulated laboratory environments.
  • Collaborate with Quality and Regulatory teams on validation strategies, verification activities, design controls, and submission-support documentation.
Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Work closely with assay development, bioinformatics, automation, clinical, quality, and regulatory teams.
  • Present study results, technical findings, and recommendations to project stakeholders.
  • Lead technical investigations and support risk mitigation activities.
  • Contribute to assay development strategy, validation planning, and project execution.
Required Qualifications:
  • Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Genetics, Genomics, Biochemistry, Bioengineering, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with cell-free nucleic acid workflows, liquid biopsy technologies, or low-input molecular assays.
  • Strong background in NGS library preparation, sequencing workflows, and molecular assay development.
  • Experience designing and executing analytical validation studies for molecular assays or NGS-based products.
  • Working knowledge of:
    • Analytical sensitivity and specificity
    • LoB, LoD, and LoQ studies
    • Precision and reproducibility assessments
    • Interference and robustness testing
    • Statistical study design and analysis
  • Experience analyzing complex experimental data and applying appropriate statistical methodologies.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, experimental design, and scientific communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a multidisciplinary environment.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience supporting development or validation of liquid biopsy, cell-free DNA (cfDNA), or other advanced molecular diagnostic assays.
  • Experience with targeted sequencing, low-frequency variant detection, DNA methylation analysis, or related technologies.
  • Familiarity with FDA-regulated diagnostic development programs and analytical validation frameworks.
  • Knowledge of CLSI guidance and quality-system requirements applicable to molecular diagnostics.
  • Experience with laboratory automation and liquid-handling systems.
  • Proficiency in R, Python, JMP, SAS, or similar analytical tools.
  • Experience with design controls, risk management, CAPA, method transfer, and assay lifecycle management.
  • Experience supporting medium- to high-throughput laboratory operations.

job.title: Scientist II, Analytical Product Development
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Scientist II, Analytics – Product Development for our pharmaceutical client in Corona, CA. In this role, you will provide analytical support for pharmaceutical product development programs, helping advance the development and approval of generic drug products for U.S. and international markets. The Scientist II will perform analytical testing, method development, validation and verification, laboratory equipment maintenance, technical documentation, and data review while collaborating with internal product development teams, CROs, and CMOs. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in analytical chemistry and hands-on experience with HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, and other pharmaceutical laboratory techniques.

Industry: Pharmaceutical / Product Development
Location: Corona, CA
Compensation: $65,000 - $75,000 per year; based upon experience
Type: Direct Hire

Job Functions
  • Perform analytical testing of raw materials, in-process samples, finished products, and stability samples using compendial and non-compendial methods.
  • Perform method development, evaluation, validation, and verification using HPLC, GC, and other analytical laboratory techniques.
  • Utilize analytical techniques including wet chemistry, spectrometry, chromatography, and physical testing.
  • Perform testing using instrumentation including HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, balances, and other laboratory equipment.
  • Accurately document laboratory testing according to Good Documentation Practices (GDP), company procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Analyze testing results and communicate findings to management in a timely manner.
  • Write, review, and execute study plans, analytical protocols, validation protocols, technical transfer protocols, and associated reports.
  • Author technical documents including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), method validation protocols/reports, and method transfer protocols/reports.
  • Review laboratory documentation, including notebooks and instrument logbooks, for calculations, data entry accuracy, and regulatory compliance.
  • Perform preventive maintenance, calibration, qualification, and routine monitoring of laboratory equipment and analytical instruments.
  • Maintain laboratory Quality Systems related to samples, standards, reagents, equipment qualification, preventive maintenance, periodic calibration, stability chambers, and controlled-environment storage cabinets.
  • Prepare sample and standard reconciliation reports and other laboratory reports as required.
  • Assist with analytical data management, including data review and control charting.
  • Collaborate with internal product development teams, CROs, and CMOs to establish timelines, understand analytical work requests, resolve technical issues, and communicate results.
  • Support the creation of study designs, method development protocols and reports, and technology transfer protocols and reports.
  • Provide timely analytical support for R&D activities associated with the development and approval of generic pharmaceutical products for U.S. and international markets.
  • Utilize Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and related software for data analysis, technical documentation, and communication.
  • Maintain strict compliance with laboratory procedures and applicable compliance programs.
  • Maintain a clean and safe laboratory work environment, including proper cleaning and storage of laboratory equipment and glassware.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by management.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in a science-related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of three (3) to six (6) years of relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of one (1) year of experience in a relevant area of Pharmaceutical R&D.
  • Strong knowledge of basic analytical chemistry principles and techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with analytical instrumentation and techniques, including HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, wet chemistry, chromatography, and spectrometry.
  • Experience with analytical method development, validation, verification, and/or method transfer.
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical R&D environments, terminology, procedures, and regulatory expectations.
  • Knowledge of Good Documentation Practices and laboratory compliance requirements.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing analytical protocols, reports, SOPs, and other technical documentation.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and similar programs.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external partners, including CROs and CMOs.
  • Ability to organize and manage analytical activities while meeting established project timelines.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate laboratory documentation and data integrity.

job.description:
Product Data & Digital Operations Specialist - EST hours!

  • 12-Month Contract
  • Fully Remote (Must Be Able to Work EST Hours)
  • 40 Hours per Week
  • Pay Rate: $35-$40/hour on W2
  • Candidates must be authorized to work directly on a W2 basis without sponsorship. No C2C arrangements.

Summary Sony Electronics is seeking a detail-oriented and technically minded Product Data & Digital Operations Specialist to support the management and governance of product information, digital assets, content syndication, and launch operations across multiple business systems.

This role serves as a key operational resource for maintaining product data accuracy, supporting new product launches, managing content syndication feeds, coordinating downstream integrations, and ensuring data consistency across various platforms.
The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, comfortable working with large datasets, and excels at coordinating activities across business, technical, and vendor teams.

Key Responsibilities Product Information Management (PIM)
  • Support day-to-day administration and maintenance of the Pimcore platform.
  • Execute product setup, updates, validation, and lifecycle management activities.
  • Review and maintain product attributes, specifications, images, documents, and marketing assets.
  • Monitor data quality and identify inconsistencies across systems.
  • Assist in governance and process improvement initiatives related to product data.
Product Launch Management
  • Support launch readiness activities, including embargo management, feed refreshes, testing, validation, and go-live support.
  • Track launch status and escalate issues impacting launch schedules.
  • Partner with business units to ensure timely availability of product content and assets.
Content Syndication Operations
  • Support onboarding and setup of new SKUs and product pages.
  • Monitor syndication feeds and investigate content delivery issues.
  • Coordinate with external vendors and retailers to resolve content discrepancies.
  • Assist in testing and validation of syndicated content updates.
Downstream System Support
  • Investigate and troubleshoot issues impacting data flow to internal downstream systems and syndication partners.
  • Coordinate with technical teams and vendors to drive issue resolution.
Operational Reporting & Analysis
  • Analyze product data quality trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Assist with audits, cleanup initiatives, and process documentation.
  • Maintain SOPs, workflows, and operational guides.
Cross-Functional Coordination
  • Serve as a liaison between business units, marketing, service, operations, IT, vendors, and offshore support teams.
  • Participate in project meetings and provide operational support for system enhancements.
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) and deployment validation activities.
  • Assist in gathering and documenting business requirements.
Required Qualifications Education
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Information Systems, Digital Operations, or a related field.
Experience
  • 3-5 years of experience supporting digital commerce, product information management, content operations, or related disciplines.
  • Experience working with product databases, content management systems, or PIM platforms.
  • Experience supporting product launches or operational programs.
  • Experience working across multiple stakeholders and departments.
Technical Skills
  • Experience with product data management or content platforms.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and data analysis.
  • Familiarity with APIs, data feeds, data imports, and system integrations.
  • Experience working with digital asset management systems.
  • Knowledge of eCommerce, retailer content requirements, or content syndication processes preferred.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Pimcore or similar PIM platforms.
  • Experience supporting retailer syndication programs.
  • Familiarity with SAP, Dealer/Reseller Portals, or digital commerce ecosystems.
  • Understanding of product lifecycle management processes.
  • Experience coordinating with external vendors and offshore support teams.

job.title: GPU Infrastructure Support Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: AI Infrastructure Support Engineer
Location: New York, NY
Type - Hybrid 4 days Onsite
Terms; Full Time
Salary- $140000/yr - $170000/yr


Our client provides a range of financial products and services in the United States and internationally. It operates through Securities Services, Market and Wealth Services, Investment and Wealth Management, and Other segments. The Securities Services segment offers custody, trust and depositary, accounting, exchange-traded funds, middle-office solutions, transfer agency, services for private equity and real estate funds, foreign exchange, securities lending, liquidity/lending services, and data analytics.

In this role, you'll make an impact in the following ways: 

  • Deliver operational support and drive issue resolution for AI infrastructure, GPU platforms, and associated production services.
  • Support the deployment, orchestration, and monitoring of AI/ML workloads across distributed environments using Kubernetes and Docker.
  • Apply hands-on expertise with NVIDIA GPU infrastructure, including A100, H100, and B200 nodes, to support provisioning, utilization, performance tuning, and ongoing platform operations.
  • Build, maintain, and optimize automation scripts and tooling using Ansible, Python and Shell scripting to improve efficiency and reliability.
  • Manage incidents, service requests, and change activity through enterprise workflow and ticketing platforms such as JIRA and ServiceNow.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams across engineering, platform, and operations to implement DevOps best practices, including CI/CD using GitLab, containerized deployment models, and secure access management through Azure AD.
  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation, including runbooks, standard operating procedures, support guides, and infrastructure architecture artifacts.
  • Diagnose and resolve networking, storage, and system performance issues affecting AI infrastructure and high-performance compute workloads.
  • Participate in a rotating on-call support model, including occasional weekend coverage, to help maintain high availability and operational excellence.
 

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong experience supporting AI infrastructure, GPU platforms, or high-performance compute environments in enterprise or production settings.
  • Hands-on experience working with NVIDIA GPU nodes, including A100, H100, and B200 systems.
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes and Docker for deploying, managing, and troubleshooting distributed workloads.
  • Proficiency in Ansible,  Python and Shell scripting for automation, tooling, and operational support tasks.
  • Experience with DevOps practices and tools, including GitLab CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and container-based delivery models.
  • Familiarity with enterprise ticketing and service management platforms such as JIRA and ServiceNow.
  • Good knowledge of networking, storage, Linux systems administration, and infrastructure troubleshooting in complex technical environments.
  • Understanding of identity and access management, including secure access controls such as Azure AD.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes and collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and provide occasional weekend support as needed.

job.title: Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability
job.description:
Job Title: Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability
Type: Full Time
Location: Holmdel, NJ
Salary: $180000 + bonus



Position Summary The Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability is responsible for defining and executing the enterprise observability strategy, operating model, and platform roadmap that enable proactive, predictive, and resilient technology operations.

This leader owns the enterprise capabilities for monitoring, telemetry, event intelligence, operational analytics, and observability engineering, ensuring technology services are observable, measurable, actionable, and continuously improving.
The role serves as the operational intelligence leader across Enterprise Technology, providing the platforms, standards, insights, and governance required to improve service reliability, accelerate issue detection and resolution, and support modern operational practices.
This leader partners closely with infrastructure, cloud, middleware, application, security, resiliency, and service management teams to build a unified enterprise-wide observability capability.

Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Observability Strategy
  • Define and execute the enterprise observability vision, strategy, operating model, and multi-year roadmap.
  • Establish standards and governance for monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, telemetry, alerting, and service observability.
  • Lead the evolution of observability capabilities from reactive monitoring toward proactive, predictive, and automated operations.
  • Drive enterprise adoption of modern observability practices, frameworks, and engineering standards.

Observability Platform Ownership
  • Own the strategy, architecture, lifecycle, and operation of enterprise monitoring and observability platforms.
  • Lead platform modernization, tool rationalization, capability expansion, and service offering improvements.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, platform investments, and cost optimization efforts.
  • Ensure scalability, availability, resilience, and ongoing enhancement of observability tooling and services.

Monitoring and Telemetry Services
  • Establish enterprise monitoring and instrumentation standards across infrastructure, cloud, middleware, applications, databases, and digital services.
  • Improve monitoring coverage, telemetry quality, alert effectiveness, signal quality, and operational visibility.
  • Drive adoption of distributed tracing, service dependency mapping, and end-to-end transaction monitoring.
  • Ensure service health and operational data are consistently available across the technology landscape.

Operational Intelligence and AIOps
  • Lead implementation of operational analytics, event intelligence, anomaly detection, predictive insights, and AIOps capabilities.
  • Develop dashboards, scorecards, and reporting that provide actionable operational intelligence to technology leadership.
  • Enable intelligent event correlation, noise reduction, automated diagnostics, and automated operational workflows.
  • Partner with engineering and operations teams to use observability data for continuous improvement and outage prevention.

Reliability and Incident Enablement
  • Partner with technology teams to improve detection, response, recovery, and root cause analysis capabilities.
  • Establish observability practices that improve service reliability, operational resilience, and customer experience.
  • Drive post-incident learning and identification of automation opportunities.
  • Provide enterprise visibility into technology health, performance trends, capacity risks, and reliability risks.

Leadership and Talent Development
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of observability engineers, platform engineers, and operational intelligence specialists.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, operational excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional partnership.
  • Lead organizational adoption of observability best practices through enablement, coaching, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Establish strong partnerships across technology, cybersecurity, architecture, engineering, operations, resiliency, and service management functions.

Qualifications
  • 10+ years of experience in infrastructure operations, platform engineering, observability, reliability engineering, or related technology disciplines.
  • 5+ years of experience leading enterprise-scale engineering or operational teams.
  • Deep expertise in observability platforms, monitoring technologies, telemetry pipelines, logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and operational analytics.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing enterprise monitoring strategies and improving operational reliability at scale.
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms, hybrid infrastructure, automation, DevOps practices, and modern operational architectures.
  • Experience leading organizational transformation and driving adoption of new operational capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and strategic planning skills.

Success Measures
  • Increased enterprise monitoring and observability coverage.
  • Reduced mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR).
  • Improved signal quality and reduced alert fatigue.
  • Increased adoption of observability standards and platform capabilities.
  • Improved service reliability, operational resilience, and operational efficiency.
  • Expansion of predictive analytics, automation, and AIOps capabilities across Enterprise Technology.

job.title: Senior Market Data Analyst - onsite Boston
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Principal to lead our Market Data and Security Master functions within the Central Data function. This is a hands-on leadership role at the center of the firm’s investment, operations, risk, and technology workflows which involves owning the integrity of reference data that powers trading, portfolio management, performance, valuation, and reporting firmwide.

The firm is undergoing a strategic data transformation, and this role will be central to its success. The successful candidate will be ready to enhance the firm’s market data strategy and contribute meaningfully to broader data quality, data governance, and AI enablement initiatives. They will sit within a small, high-impact team supporting firmwide shared data needs including product master, security master, reference data and vendors, data quality, and data governance. The role combines deep subject matter expertise in financial instrument and market reference data with strong commercial discipline and the relationship-building skills needed to operate as a trusted partner to functional leaders across the firm

Key Responsibilities

Security & Product Master
  • Own end-to-end governance of the firm’s security master, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness across all instruments (equities, fixed income, derivatives, FX). Contribute to the fund master function as needed, including support on setup and review of hedge fund and private market products.
  • Establish and maintain golden-source standards, data models, identifier hierarchies (CUSIP, ISIN, SEDOL, FIGI, LEI, internal IDs), and instrument lifecycle workflows from onboarding through retirement.
  • Define and enforce data quality controls, exception management, and reconciliation processes across the front-to-back data flow; resolve breaks impacting trading, operations, accounting, and risk.
  • Oversee corporate actions, pricing, ratings, classifications, and issuer/entity reference data, including legal entity hierarchies and counterparty data.
Market Data Strategy & Delivery
  • Establish and own the firm’s market data strategy, shaping how the firm sources, integrates, and consumes market data over the coming years.
  • Lead sourcing, integration, and quality assurance of real-time, intraday, and end-of-day market data feeds across asset classes.
  • Manage entitlements and permissioning, ensuring adherence to licensing terms and redistribution policies.
  • Translate evolving investment, trading, and operational data requirements into scalable, well-controlled solutions, working hand-in-hand with the teams that consume the data.
  • Monitor industry trends — new content sets, regulatory changes, and vendor product evolution — and ensure the firm’s market data capabilities stay ahead of business needs.
Data Transformation, Governance & AI Enablement
  • Contribute as a leader to the firm’s broader data transformation agenda, including data quality, data governance, and AI enablement initiatives.
  • Ensure the firm’s reference and market data foundations are fit for purpose to support advanced analytics and AI use cases.
  • Partner with Technology and other Data Management leaders on platform modernization, lineage, metadata, and control frameworks.
Stakeholder Partnership & Delivery Management
  • Build productive relationships with functional leaders across Research, CIO, Operations, Reporting, Risk, Finance, Compliance, and Technology.
  • Establish and maintain a prioritization framework and delivery roadmap that balances competing demands, trade-offs, and aligns the team’s work with business outcomes.
Vendor Management & Budget Stewardship
  • Own commercial relationships with major market and reference data providers. Lead contract negotiation, renewals, and rationalization. Identify opportunities cost savings.
  • Own the market and reference data budget end-to-end including forecasting, tracking actuals against budget, and ROI tracking for new spend.
Required Qualifications
  • 7–10 years of experience in market data and/or reference data within an investment manager, hedge fund, asset owner, or comparable financial services environment.
  • 3+ years management experience
  • Expertise across security master and market data domains. Strong working knowledge of the major market and reference data providers and their content sets across asset classes.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships. Familiarity with market data licensing and usage restrictions.
  • Demonstrated ability to build cross-functional relationships with senior business stakeholders and translate their needs into delivery plans.
  • Experience contributing to or leading data transformation initiatives, including data quality and data governance programs.
  • Deep understanding of instrument data across asset classes, including identifiers, classifications, corporate actions, and pricing.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to operate fluently across business stakeholders, technologists, and vendors.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; finance, economics, computer science, or related field preferred.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Exposure to private markets and alternatives reference data.
  • Experience contributing to AI / ML enablement from a data foundations perspective.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks) and data governance tooling (Collibra, Alation).
  • CFA, CIPM, or DAMA-CDMP certifications viewed favorably.

Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Production Technician in Rockville, MD.  The Production Technician will support the veterinary diagnostic manufacturing processes. General responsibilities include assembling, filling, labeling, and kitting small light-weight products in a manufacturing laboratory environment. The position will also assist with order picking, packing and warehousing.

  • Performing Manual tasks such as bottle filling and device assembly, pouching, labeling, and kitting.
  • Adhere to and accurately complete production documentation.
  • Perform set-ups, changeovers, and cleanups of work areas.
  • Maintain a safe and clean working environment.
  • Assistance with warehouse order picking, packing, and general warehousing.
Targeted Skills:
  • Comprehensive understanding of basic scientific principles and biotech manufacturing processes.
  • Comprehensive understanding of and experience with GMP and ISO regulations.
  • Able to communicate technical matters clearly and professionally while guiding teams to compliant, creative.
  • solutions, Able to communicate clearly and firmly when noncompliant or potentially non-compliant situations are identified.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment handling multiple priorities with attention to meeting deadlines while working effectively and efficiently.
  • A willingness to think outside of the box and adapt industry best practices and trends to our small but growing business.
